data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 Pattern is a leading eCommerce accelerator with offices across the globe offering outsourced marketplace and ecommerce management services for brands worldwide. The Pattern Ecommerce Acceleration Platform leverages AI\-powered technology, industry expertise, and global distribution, logistics, and fulfilment services to help quality brands scale profitably on their own websites and through hundreds of marketplaces. Pattern works with some of the most recognized brands such as Thorne, Naturelo, Marshall, Nutricost, MegaFood, TIGI, Hair Burst and Sage and it ranks among the top 5 Amazon sellers globally.
   

  

 Pattern is expanding and we are looking for an experienced Ecommerce expert to join our MENA Team in Dubai to support the scaling of the business by driving the performance of the brands we represent on Amazon and other Marketplaces.
   

  

 You will own the relationship and financial performance of a portfolio of global brands managing their performance across marketplaces here in MENA. You will support the Associate Director of eCommercewith defining and implementing the E2E growth and profitability plan for your portfolio of brands by working cross\-functionally with Operations, Content, Advertising, Creative, Merchandising and Finance. You will also lead cross\-functional projects to implement processes to scale the organisation in MENA. You will be a strategic and commercial ecommerce professional who can engage partners and internal stakeholders towards a common goal. You will have a growth mindset and love navigating the challenges of working in fast changing landscapes.
   

  

**The core responsibilities of the eCommerce Manager reflect the following**
* Drive revenue growth on marketplaces across MENA through a data\-driven approach across a portfolio of brands through B2B and D2C marketplaces.
* Ensure that a clear activity plan is in place to achieve and surpass the budget targets, including promotional planning, seasonal phasing, NPD launches, advertising campaigns etc.
* Define the strategy and joint business plan with our brands to create mutually beneficial sales and marketing plans which grow market share.
* Represent your brands brilliantly across Marketplaces through best\-in\-class product content, including but not limited to images, enhanced content, keyword SEO, local language translation, advertising campaigns etc.
* Conduct analysis of brands performance using multiple data sources and tools on a regular basis to ensure that performance is continuously optimised across all touch points.
* Manage inventory, working alongside our merchandisers to maintain a healthy pipeline
* .Establish and maintain relationships with appropriate client partners, providing day\-to\-day contact on project status and changes.
* Have a passion for continuous improvement and building and automating processes.


**What will I need to thrive in this role?﻿**
* Demonstrated success in managing an ecommerce business
* 2\-5 years experience in an ecommerce role
* Strong academic background (2:1 or above)
* Previous experience managing and growing 3P business on Marketplaces (Amazon and Noon)
* Creative thinker and problem solver
* Highly organized and disciplined
* Willing to be nimble and adaptable to change
* Able to work under pressure and manage workloads effectively
* Arabic fluency preferred to facilitate communication with local market clients


**We Are Looking For Individuals Who Are**
**Game Changers** 
 \- A game changer is someone who looks at problems with an open mind and shares new ideas with team members, regularly reassesses existing plans and attaches a realistic timeline to goals, makes profitable, productive, and innovative contributions, and actively pursues improvements to Pattern’s processes and outcomes.
   

  

**Data Fanatics** 
 \- A data fanatic is someone who recognizes problems and seeks to understand them through data, draws unbiased conclusions based on data that lead to actionable solutions, and continues to track the effects of the solutions using data.
   

  

**Partner Obsessed** 
 \- An individual who is partner obsessed clearly explains the status of projects to partners and relies on constructive feedback, actively listens to partner’s expectations and delivers results that exceed them, prioritises the needs of your partners, and takes the time to create a personable experience for those interacting with Pattern.
   

  

**Team of Doers** 
 \- Someone who is a part of team of doers uplifts team members and recognizes their specific contributions, takes initiative to help in any circumstance, actively contributes to supporting improvements, and holds themselves accountable to the team as well as to partners.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

**Job Description**
**We Are The People Who Give Possibilities Purpose**
 BD is one of the largest global medical technology companies in the world. Advancing the world of health™ is our Purpose, and it’s no small feat. It takes the imagination and passion of all of us—from design and engineering to the manufacturing and marketing of our billions of MedTech products per year—to look at the impossible and find transformative solutions that turn dreams into possibilities.
   

  

****Job Description****
**Position Summary**
 The Director, Strategic Initiatives is responsible for leading the identification, development, and execution of high\-impact critical initiatives that drive business growth, operational excellence, and transformation across the region and/or global function.
   

  

 This role works closely with senior leadership to translate strategic priorities into actionable plans. It ensures alignment across commercial, operational, and functional groups. It delivers measurable outcomes within a sophisticated, matrixed environment.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
**Strategic Planning \& Execution**
* Translate enterprise and regional strategy into executable initiatives and implementation roadmaps
* Define clear milestones, KPIs, and success measures aligned to business priorities
* Drive alignment between global strategy and regional execution


**Transformation \& Change Leadership**
* Lead cross\-functional transformation initiatives across commercial, operational, and digital domains
* Act as a change agent to drive adoption of new processes, tools, and ways of working
* Ensure sustainability and scalability of implemented initiatives


**Program \& Portfolio Management**
* Manage a portfolio of pivotal initiatives end\-to\-end (from concept to execution)
* Establish governance frameworks, including tracking progress, risks, and dependencies
* Ensure delivery of initiatives on time, within scope, and delivering measurable impact


**Business Analytics \& Performance Insights**
* Lead all aspects of the development and use of analytics, dashboards, and reporting tools
* Provide insights on business performance, trends, and improvement opportunities
* Support data\-driven decision making across leadership teams


**Financial Planning \& Performance Management**
* Support financial planning processes including Annual Budget, Forecasts, and ASR cycles
* Supervise and evaluate financial impact of central initiatives
* Find opportunities for revenue growth, cost optimization, and efficiency improvements


**Cross\-functional Teamwork \& Partner Management**
* Partner with Commercial, Finance, Supply Chain, Operations, HR, and other functions
* Influence senior partners and align priorities across regions
* Drive execution through teamwork in a matrix environment


**Qualifications**
**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree required (Business, Finance, Engineering, or related field)
* MBA or equivalent advanced degree or equivalent experience preferred


**Experience**
* Meaningful progressive experience in strategy, consulting, commercial operations, or transformation
* Proven experience leading sophisticated, cross\-functional critical initiatives
* Experience working in global, matrixed organizations preferred


**Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities**
* Strong critical thinking and execution capability
* Sophisticated analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Strong financial savvy and understanding of business drivers
* Excellent collaborator management and influencing skills
* Proven program and project management expertise
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced, ambiguous environment


**Leadership Proficiencies (BD\-style)**

* Strategic Attitude: Translates vision into executable strategies
* Cultivates Collaboration: Works effectively across boundaries
* Influences \& Communicates: Engages and aligns partners at all levels
* Manages Complexity: Navigates ambiguity and drives clarity


**Key Performance Indicators.**
* Execution and delivery of pivotal initiatives (timeline, scope, quality)
* Financial impact (revenue growth, cost savings, margin improvement)
* Adoption and sustainability of transformation programs
* Improvement in commercial and operational performance metrics.


**Key Relationships**
* President META and META Leadership Team
* Country General Managers
* Key customers, clinicians, KOLs, and strategic partners
* Finance, Commercial, Supply Chain, Operations, HR


**Additional Information**
* Role requires travel across META markets.
* Position operates in a highly regulated healthcare environment with significant governance requirements.

( 20117 )
   

  

 At Kerzner, we never settle. Through continued innovation, our team of pioneers push until the next level is achieved, and then to keep going. Our philosophy is simple \- we go above and beyond to Blow Away our Guest and Colleagues. Good enough never is. For us, it is all about perfection and innovation. This is not simply our job, it’s our passion.
   

  

 Our Colleagues are at the heart of who we are and what we do. With an international team of over 10,000 Colleagues and strong strategic growth on the horizon, we offer unrivalled career opportunities around the world. We are committed to provide our Colleagues at all levels with opportunities to grow and develop within the organisation through personalised development plans and tailored succession planning. We invest in our communities to sustain the environment where we operate and minimising our own footprint. Whether it is through animal conservation, education or tree\-planting, we like to give back in as many ways as we can to help our communities flourish.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Following our mission of enriching lives by connecting people, places and meaningful experiences, Kerzner International has created iconic destination resorts, luxury hotels, and private homes. With the continuous expansion of our portfolio, we are looking for Revenue Management professionals who are willing to relocate to Southern Europe/Eastern Europe region for a property\-based role.
   

  

 Cluster Director of Revenue Management across Kerzner International properties will be responsible for executing the implementation of the strategic long\-term Total Revenue Plan into actionable results that directly affect properties’ performance for Rooms, Food and Beverage, Spa, Retail and other Revenue Centers. The role is based on\-site and oversees multiple properties, reporting to the General Manager, with a dotted line to Global Revenue Team in Dubai.
   

  

**Key duties and responsibilities include but are not limited to:**
* Further develop the property distribution platform by identifying best solution for CRS/GDS and ensuring available revenue management technology is fully utilized and understood according to property specific business mix and requirements
* Ensure optimal use, and measure performance on all distribution channels, to ensure that fair market share is achieved if not surpassed
* Assist the Sales \& Marketing Team in devising marketing campaigns, to ensure that the Hotel reaches the right source markets, at the right time, in the right place
* Monitor competitor availability and pricing and subsequently analyze \& report actual performance versus competitive set.
* Implement pricing strategies, yield strategies, selling strategies and revenue management best practices; investigate and communicate new ways to capture optimal revenue potentials.
* Develop \& implement rationally related pricing structures for Direct, Wholesale, Groups \& Corporate with cohesive synergies between the segments.
* Understand the dynamics of the Global, National, Regional \& Local Political and Economic Market, local Competitors and all demand generators for the destination.
* Carry out analysis of Booking Patterns \& Market Trends and ensure that these are recorded to facilitate future decisions.
* Conduct annual revenue management audits for all revenue generating departments.
* Drive Projects related to revenue management.


**We are looking for candidates who can demonstrate the below skills and qualities:**
* at least 5 years in similar position within luxury hospitality, ideally in a relevant 5 star property based capacity

data.jd_text:
A leading global consultancy is seeking a Regional Finance Director to provide strategic direction and expert guidance for their regional finance unit based in Dubai. This pivotal role offers you the opportunity to shape the financial agenda across multiple countries, partnering closely with senior leaders to drive business growth and ensure robust financial management. You would ideally be based in the UAE with proven regional experience.
 



**What you'll do:** 




 As Regional Finance Director, you will be entrusted with overseeing all aspects of financial management across a diverse regional portfolio. Your day\-to\-day responsibilities will involve setting strategic direction for the finance unit, guiding teams through complex challenges, and ensuring high standards of accuracy in reporting. You will work collaboratively with senior leaders to deliver business plans while maintaining rigorous controls that safeguard assets. By establishing clear KPIs and analytics frameworks, you will monitor progress against objectives and provide actionable insights. Your expertise will be crucial in managing statutory audits, preparing detailed accounts for internal and external stakeholders, and supporting company\-wide initiatives such as bid document preparation or project risk reviews. You will also play an integral role in sustainability efforts by sharing responsibility for carbon emissions reduction during project delivery. Success in this role requires you to foster a high\-performing team culture that exceeds expectations while promoting health, safety, wellbeing, and inclusivity throughout the organisation.
 






* Lead the implementation of the regional finance strategy for a designated portfolio, ensuring strategic plans are executed effectively and operational delivery aligns with organisational priorities.
* Maintain an effective financial control environment that mitigates risks of fraud or error, protecting cash, systems, investments, and other assets across the regional portfolio.
* Establish analytics and key performance indicators (KPIs) for monitoring the execution of the regional finance strategy, providing clear insights into progress and outcomes.
* Act as a finance business partner to the Managing Director for the region, supporting the execution of business plans and driving commercial success.
* Collaborate with the Chief Finance Officer as part of the finance leadership team, offering expertise and counsel on all strategic finance matters within the designated portfolio.
* Oversee comprehensive financial reporting adhering to international accounting standards (IFRS), managing statutory audits and ensuring accurate accounts across subsidiaries.
* Manage monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc management accounts and reporting requirements to meet statutory, fiduciary, country\-specific obligations.
* Review unallocated staff across the regional portfolio, proactively identifying risks or opportunities that may impact sector financial performance.
* Provide monthly reviews of pipeline prospects with senior business stakeholders, ensuring leads and target gaps are accurately reported for executive summaries.
* Issue regular debtors reports and accrued income reports, taking timely action on invoicing and collections while maintaining compliance with third\-party reporting obligations.







**What you bring:** 




 Your proven experience as Regional Finance Director will demonstrate comprehensive knowledge of financial leadership within complex environments. You bring advanced skills in managing multi\-country portfolios using international accounting standards alongside deep expertise in audit processes. Your full accountancy qualifications underpin your ability to deliver accurate reporting while maintaining rigorous controls. You excel at communicating effectively across all levels\-engaging C\-Suite executives as well as nurturing professional networks externally. Your capacity for analytical thinking enables you to identify risks proactively while leveraging opportunities for improvement. As an inspiring leader who builds cohesive teams focused on shared goals, you are adept at guiding both direct and indirect reports towards exceeding performance targets. Your digital literacy ensures seamless integration of technology into daily operations while your commitment to continuous learning supports ongoing professional development. With significant experience in consultancy or related sectors, you understand industry best practices intimately\-making you an invaluable asset capable of driving transformational change.
 






* Comprehensive expertise in financial leadership within industry settings, demonstrated by a track record of achievement leading large or complex finance units or sub\-functions.
* Advanced knowledge of international accounting standards (IFRS) with proven experience managing statutory audits and preparing accurate financial reports for multi\-country portfolios.
* Highly developed analytical skills combined with advanced budgetary expertise to oversee complex financial planning processes.
* Expertise in audit and risk management practices that ensure robust controls are maintained across all areas of responsibility.
* Full accountancy qualification such as ACA (Associate Chartered Accountant), ACCA (Association of Chartered Certified Accountants), CIMA (Chartered Institute of Management Accountants), or equivalent certification.
* Significant relevant experience in finance leadership roles at regional or multi\-country level within consultancy or similar industries.
* Advanced communication skills enabling effective engagement at C\-Suite level as well as building strong relationships with internal teams and external partners including auditors, bankers, insurance brokers, tax advisors, joint venture partners.
* Proven ability to manage direct reports (1\-4\) as well as indirect reports (over 8\), fostering collaborative teamwork that delivers high performance against KPIs \& OKDs.
* Digitally savvy with technical literacy including working proficiency in Oracle systems for efficient data analysis \& reporting.
* Strategic thinking capabilities paired with inspiring leadership qualities that build effective finance teams focused on delivering organisational objectives.







**What's next:** 




 If you are ready to take your career to new heights by joining a collaborative team dedicated to excellence in regional finance leadership, apply now!
 







 Apply today by clicking on the link provided.

data.raw_snippet:

data.jd_text:
**About our client**
 We are representing an exceptional opportunity with a leading investment office in Dubai that is looking to hire a Vice President into a newly created Group Treasury role. The position will lead the day\-to\-day treasury function across a diversified investment platform spanning public markets and a private investments portfolio, including fund commitments and co\-investments. This is a hands\-on, high\-impact role suited to a technically strong treasury professional who thrives in a high\-accountability environment. This role will require full relocation to Dubai.
   

  

**What the job involves**
* Manage day\-to\-day treasury operations across multiple entities and jurisdictions, including cash management, payments, reconciliations, bank administration, and operational banking relationships
* Lead group\-wide liquidity management, cash forecasting, and cash positioning, integrating investment pipeline activity including capital calls, distributions, and co\-investment funding requirements
* Develop liquidity stress testing, contingency funding plans, and early warning indicators to proactively manage funding risk
* Oversee intercompany funding, cash pooling, and banking structures to optimise liquidity efficiency across the group
* Execute yield enhancement strategies for surplus cash across approved short\-duration investment\-grade instruments in line with treasury policy and risk appetite
* Manage revolving credit facilities, including utilisation, drawdowns, repayments, covenant compliance, lender reporting, and optimisation of funding costs
* Lead banking and financing relationships, including facility renewals, new financing arrangements, counterparty management, and negotiation of commercial terms
* Execute and manage the Group’s FX hedging programme, including spot, forwards, swaps, collateral management, and ISDA/CSA documentation
* Monitor market and macroeconomic developments and assess implications for liquidity, financing, and hedging strategies
* Maintain treasury policies, controls, and reporting frameworks, ensuring strong governance, operational controls, and audit readiness
* Prepare treasury reporting, liquidity analysis, and presentation materials for senior management, Board, and investment committee stakeholders


**Who we are looking for**
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, or a related discipline
* Advanced degree and/or professional qualification (MBA, MSc Finance, CFA, ACT) preferred
* Group Treasury experience within a global financial or corporate institution
* Strong technical expertise across cash and liquidity management, treasury operations, FX hedging, collateral management, credit facilities, covenant compliance, and yield enhancement
* Proven experience managing revolving credit facilities, subscription finance lines, and lender relationships, including reporting, renewals, and covenant oversight
* Hands\-on knowledge of ISDA/CSA documentation, FX forwards, margining, and collateral processes
* Experience supporting private investment programmes, including capital call funding, liquidity forecasting, and FX hedging of fund and co\-investment exposures
* Strong financial modelling and analytical skills, with experience in liquidity forecasting, covenant headroom analysis, and treasury reporting
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively with senior leadership, lenders, and external counterparties

data.jd_text:
Our client is a UAE\-based investment group with a diversified portfolio spanning multiple high\-growth industries. They are seeking an experienced
 **Finance Director/CFO** 
 to lead their global finance function and operational infrastructure. As the organisation continues to expand across multiple jurisdictions, this role will be instrumental in establishing institutional\-grade financial processes, governance frameworks, and reporting standards while supporting strategic growth initiatives.
 



  





**Role Requirement** 




 This is a highly strategic yet hands\-on leadership position that extends beyond traditional finance responsibilities, encompassing operations, compliance, corporate structuring, and executive support. The successful candidate will work closely with the firm's principals and play a key role in shaping the financial and operational framework of the business.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Financial Leadership \& Strategy** 



* Design, implement, and oversee robust financial policies, controls, and reporting frameworks across multiple international entities.
* Lead the firm's overall financial strategy, ensuring scalability, transparency, and operational excellence.
* Develop and maintain sophisticated cash flow forecasts, budgeting processes, and financial planning models.
* Provide strategic financial insights and recommendations to senior leadership to support investment and business decisions.



  





**Accounting \& Financial Reporting** 



* Oversee all accounting operations, including general ledger management, reconciliations, month\-end and year\-end close processes.
* Consolidate financial statements across multiple jurisdictions and corporate structures.
* Ensure timely and accurate statutory and management reporting in accordance with IFRS and relevant accounting standards.
* Monitor and manage intercompany transactions and reconciliations across the group's entities



  





**Investment \& Portfolio Oversight** 



* Prepare detailed reporting for principals covering portfolio performance, consolidated assets, liquidity positions, and investment metrics.
* Review financial models, business plans, and due diligence materials relating to existing and prospective investments.
* Support investment decisions through financial analysis and commercial evaluation.
* Assist portfolio companies with fundraising initiatives, financial modelling, corporate finance structuring, and investor engagement where required.



  





**Compliance, Corporate Structuring \& Governance** 



* Oversee compliance across multiple jurisdictions, ensuring adherence to local and international regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate corporate structuring initiatives, including SPVs, trusts, offshore and onshore entities, and jurisdictional expansions.
* Manage relationships with external auditors, legal advisers, tax consultants, bankers, and other professional service providers.
* Supervise licensing, statutory filings, board reporting, and other corporate governance obligations.
* Review and manage the organisation's insurance programmes and risk mitigation strategies.



  





**Operations \& Administration** 



* Build and oversee efficient internal operational processes across finance and administration.
* Manage corporate expenses and implement cost control initiatives.
* Support broader business operations including contract management, asset administration, HR\-related processes, and internal controls.
* Develop scalable systems that enable institutional\-quality governance across the organisation.



  





**Risk Management** 



* Identify and proactively manage financial, operational, and regulatory risks.
* Ensure effective tax planning and compliance across multiple jurisdictions.
* Stay informed of evolving accounting standards, tax legislation, and regulatory developments impacting the business.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related discipline.
* MBA or Master's degree is advantageous.
* Professional qualification such as CPA, ACCA, ACA, or CFA is required.
* Minimum of 10 years' experience in finance, accounting, auditing, or corporate finance, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership role.
* Demonstrated experience within private equity, venture capital, family office, or institutional investment environments is essential.
* Strong expertise in multi\-entity consolidations, intercompany accounting, and international financial reporting.
* Deep understanding of IFRS, corporate governance, compliance, and international tax frameworks.
* Experience overseeing operational functions beyond finance, including administration and business processes, is highly desirable.
* Must be based in Dubai or willing to relocate.



  





**Ideal candidate will come from a Family Office / VC / Institutional background. The role will suit a Senior level candidate who is currently working with a Family Office or Private Equity Fund.** 




  





**Desired Attributes** 



* Strategic thinker with the ability to balance high\-level planning and hands\-on execution.
* Exceptional analytical skills and meticulous attention to detail.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience supporting investment decision\-making.
* Proven ability to build processes and elevate organisations to institutional standards.
* High level of integrity, professionalism, and discretion, with confidentiality being essential to the role.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Comfortable operating in a dynamic, entrepreneurial, and fast\-paced international environment.
* Proactive problem solver who anticipates challenges and delivers practical solutions.



  





 This is a unique opportunity to join a high\-growth global investment platform and work directly alongside its principals, helping to build world\-class financial and operational infrastructure while supporting a diverse international portfolio. To apply for this role, please forward your CV using the link.
 



  





 For additional information about open vacancies and events we are attending, please feel free to
 **follow our LinkedIn Page** 
 . We are presently working on numerous client roles at BlockDelta.

Outstanding project management skills and ability to bring clarity and discipline to the transformation agenda. Excellent communication skills and ability to simplify.
* Relationships: collaborative team player who thrives working in an agile and ambiguous environment, demonstrating solid people skills, working well x\-function and x\-BU to align behind goals and delivery

data.raw_snippet:
**Job Description**

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 The Project Portfolio Management (PPM) Senior Manager is responsible for leading and institutionalizing enterprise\-wide portfolio management practices, ensuring all initiatives are strategically aligned, financially governed, and executed with full transparency.
   

  

 This role acts as a critical bridge between strategy and execution, ensuring that strategic priorities are translated into a governed, optimized, and value\-driven portfolio of initiatives. It will drive the transformation from fragmented project execution into a structured, data\-driven portfolio model, addressing key challenges such as inconsistent demand intake, lack of project classification, limited financial visibility, and weak governance enforcement.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Strategic Planning, Direction \& Alignment
* Partner with executive leadership to support the development and refinement of organizational strategy
* Ensure clear linkage between strategy, initiatives, and measurable business outcomes
* Establish mechanisms to continuously align portfolio execution with evolving strategic priorities
* Lead strategic planning cycles from a portfolio perspective (initiative shaping, sequencing, and dependencies)
* Define and govern strategic KPIs and value realization frameworks across the portfolio
* Portfolio Strategy \& Governance
* Define and lead the enterprise\-wide PPM framework, standards, and operating model
* Translate strategic objectives into a structured and governed project portfolio
* Establish portfolio segmentation (e.g., strategic, regulatory, operational, innovation)
* Ensure alignment between portfolio investments and organizational strategy
* Demand Management \& Intake Control
* Design and enforce a centralized demand intake and approval process
* Institutionalize project classification standards (project vs. BAU vs. enhancement)
* Ensure all requests are captured through a unified platform (eliminating shadow processes)
* Ensure all initiatives are uniquely identified and tracked
* Portfolio Prioritization \& Optimization
* Establish and govern a standardized prioritization model (value, cost, risk, dependencies)
* Lead portfolio planning cycles and continuous reprioritization
* Optimize resource allocation across competing initiatives
* Manage trade\-offs and scenario analysis at portfolio level
* Financial Governance \& Value Realization
* Own portfolio\-level financial oversight, including budget alignment and tracking
* Ensure project\-level budget visibility and linkage to financial systems
* Monitor financial performance (actuals vs. forecast vs. approved budgets)
* Drive benefits realization tracking and value measurement
* Governance \& Performance Management
* Define and enforce portfolio governance frameworks, stage gates, and approval workflows
* Define portfolio KPIs, SLAs, and performance metrics
* Establish executive\-level dashboards and reporting standards
* Provide actionable insights on portfolio health, risks, and dependencies
* Escalate and manage underperforming or at\-risk initiatives
* Tools, Data \& Systems Integration
* Lead the implementation and governance of PPM tools and platforms
* Ensure integration across systems (e.g., Jira, ERP, procurement systems)
* Eliminate duplication and enforce a single source of truth
* Standardize project structures (WBS, PO linkage, renewals, etc.)
* Reporting \& Executive Insights
* Provide executive dashboards and portfolio insights (status, risks, financials, dependencies)
* Enable data\-driven decision\-making through accurate and timely reporting
* Communicate portfolio health to senior leadership
* Continuous Improvement \& Maturity Development
* Assess current maturity and define a PPM maturity roadmap
* Benchmark against best practices (e.g., PMI (Project Management Institute), Axelos)
* Continuously refine governance, processes, and performance frameworks
* Lead transformation initiatives to enhance portfolio effectiveness


**Qualifications**
**Job Requirements**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, IT, Engineering, or a related field
* Master's degree or MBA with a technology management or digital strategy focus (preferred).


**Experience**
* 10–15\+ years of experience in Project, Program, or Portfolio Management
* Proven experience in establishing or transforming PPM functions at enterprise level
* Demonstrated experience developing or contributing to digital transformation strategies and multi\-year technology roadmaps.
* Proven track record of designing and running portfolio prioritization frameworks in organizations with competing demands and resource constraints.
* Experience in complex, multi\-stakeholder environments
* Strong exposure to financial governance, budgeting, and investment planning
* Experience leading a team or function; not just managing projects, but managing people and building a practice


 Certifications
   

  

* PMP — Project Management Professional, PMI or equivalent (required).
* PMI\-PfMP — Portfolio Management Professional, or PgMP — Program Management Professional (highly preferred; demonstrated willingness to certify is acceptable).


 Leadership \& Core Competencies
   

  

* Strategic thinker; able to hold the long\-term direction and the immediate decision simultaneously, without losing sight of either
* Influential communicator; builds alignment across peers, teams, and leadership through clarity, credibility, and consistency.
* Strong governance design and enforcement capability
* Advanced financial and analytical skills
* Decision\-making under ambiguity
* Transformation and change leadership
* Structured problem\-solving.


**LI\-DNP**

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 The Senior Commercial Director for KSA, Bahrain, and Kuwait is responsible for shaping and executing a long‑term (3–5 year) commercial strategy with a strong focus on accelerating growth in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia—one of Hilton’s most strategically important markets, expected to exceed 100 hotels within five years.
   

  

 This role leads the development of the value proposition and investment cases required to unlock this growth, ensuring the right commercial foundations are established across Sales, Marketing, Distribution, and Revenue functions. The appointee will assess organizational design needs, budget requirements, talent capabilities, and performance enablers needed for sustained market leadership.
   

  

 The Senior Commercial Director is accountable for delivering top‑tier commercial performance across the three markets and driving market share growth. The role includes hiring, developing, and mentoring high‑potential talent, ensuring alignment with Hilton’s strategic priorities while fostering a culture that reflects Hilton’s values.
   

  

 A critical success factor is the ability to build strong, influential partnerships with senior commercial leaders, regional and brand teams, GMs, ownership groups, and cross‑functional stakeholders. The role requires exceptional communication, analytical rigor, and strategic thinking to solve complex business challenges and enable sustained success.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**What will I be doing?**
**Business Acumen**
* Partner with the VP Commercial Services and Commercial Director MEA to develop long‑term regional strategy, business cases, and stakeholder alignment.
* Serve as the commercial business partner to the VP Operations for KSA, Bahrain, and Kuwait.
* Lead, coach, and develop the Commercial Director, enabling them to own near‑term tactical execution.
* Support new hotel openings from a commercial perspective, leveraging Hilton’s full commercial engine (RMCC, HWS, shared sales offices, Marketing, F\&B, HRCC).
* Translate organizational goals into clear performance standards for the Commercial Services team.


**Setting Strategy**
* Develop medium‑ and long‑term commercial strategies to drive sustained, above‑market revenue performance across all three markets.
* Clearly communicate strategic priorities, progress, and results to internal and external stakeholders.
* Gain senior‑level alignment and sponsorship for key initiatives required to deliver strategic outcomes.
* Lead strategic planning within the Commercial Services team to advance enterprise goals and ensure consistent communication.


**Executing for Results**
* Lead negotiations with third‑party partners and suppliers as required.
* Collaborate cross‑functionally with Revenue, Sales, F\&B, Marketing, eCommerce, and Finance teams, as well as commercial leadership across MEA and EMEA.
* Ensure all commercial initiatives are effectively planned, resourced, and executed.
* Drive integrated commercial action across functions to maximize RevPAR and market share.


**Leading Teams**
* Ensure Commercial Services teams provide strong support to on‑property commercial teams.
* Build and maintain a high‑performing talent pipeline, developing future leaders and succession plans.
* Create a culture of performance, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.


**Building Relationships and Influencing**
* Develop strong relationships across senior leadership to enable alignment and collaboration.
* Strengthen partnerships with MEA and EMEA commercial teams to elevate commercial performance.
* Maintain effective coordination with global commercial functions, including Database Management, HRCC, Distribution, and Channel Management.
* Represent the commercial function at property visits, corporate meetings, owner meetings, and business reviews.


**Qualifications**
**What are we looking for?**
* Demonstrated experience operating at a regional level with responsibility for a portfolio of no fewer than 20 hotels, including oversight of commercial performance, stakeholder engagement, and strategic execution across multiple countries. Proven track record in high‑growth markets, ideally with exposure to environments experiencing 4x\+ growth rates, where rapid scaling, agility, and commercial innovation are essential.
* Strong relationship building skills
* Ability to effectively plan and proactively communicate/manage expectations with stakeholders that may include both internal and external partners (project sponsors/ senior leadership team)
* Experience in working in a matrix organization
* Experience in Revenue Management, Sales \& Marketing
* Presents clear and logical arguments and decision based on factual data.
* Quick and accurate when evaluating complex written and numerical information.
* Develops constructive relationships at all levels within the organization.
* Demonstrates leadership and effectively motivates teams, helps others when needed.
* Maintains effectiveness in situations of disappointment or high pressure.
* Adapts willingly to change.
* Identifies priorities effectively, balancing importance, urgency and resources.
* Manages own personal time efficiently within tight schedules.
* Strategic thinker while translating financial goals into operational plans
* Previous experience in Change management and organisational design.
* Storytelling and ability to create, business cases, presentations to gain stakeholder buy\-in.
* Dynamic, innovative, and creative in finding business solutions
* Works effectively and accurately in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to challenge while maintaining strong relationships
* A high level of emotional intelligence and interpersonal skills with the ability to provide and receive professional, constructive feedback that elevates individual performance and job satisfaction


**About The Team**
**How We’ll Help You Thrive**
**Benefits**
 At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including\*:
   

  

 Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40 USD/night at our world\-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
   

  

 Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
   

  

 Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
   

  

 Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Through our Care for All hub, we provide resources to help our Team Members to care for themselves and their loved ones. In many countries, eligible Team Members receive free counseling and support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
   

  

* Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

 We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
   

 ​
   

 Diversity \& Inclusion​
   

 TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. data.jd_text:
TheSoul Group is a global media company with over a decade of experience building and operating digital businesses at scale. With a presence across 60 platforms, content distributed in 21 languages, and more than 100 billion monthly views, we have established one of the largest and most operationally sophisticated media footprints in the world. Our remote\-first team, spanning 85\+ countries, has grown by solving — at real scale — the exact organisational and operational challenges most companies struggle with.
   

  

 That operational depth is the foundation of Valis — TheSoul Group's brand new business and AI platform for enterprise transformation. Valis is an institutional AI operating layer for mid\-market organisations (roughly 200\-2,000 employees). It sits across a company's systems, runs one shared, org\-wide "brain" on everything the company knows, and applies encoded operator judgment on every answer — so the value of AI compounds for the company, not just for individuals using per\-seat chatbots.
   

  

 Valis is already proven in production — built from real transformation work, encoding operational experience rather than theory — and we are now scaling its deployment to mid\-market companies worldwide.
   

  

 We are seeking a Client Deployment Lead, AI to embed on\-site alongside mid\-market CEOs and make their AI\-Native transformation real on the ground. You work as a tight pod: you on\-site owning the CEO relationship and the result and you drive the rollout to a finance\-verified outcome, with elite remote engineers shipping the product configuration behind you. Every CEO who watches you land the transformation becomes the proof that wins the next one. This role is the engine of our go\-to\-market.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own the client\-CEO relationship and the executive steering committee — as a peer, with real decision rights
* Run the transformation cadence: weekly reviews, monthly finance\-verified value reviews, and quarterly business reviews
* Drive a fast, fixed\-scope first win on the client's real data, then lead the full rollout (leadership first, then the wider team)
* Translate client problems into crisp, build\-ready specs for remote engineers; own adoption and sign\-off
* Be personally accountable for a finance\-verified outcome the client can see in their P\&L
* Build a portfolio of 2\-3 marquee CEO accounts as each engagement matures
* Own end\-to\-end rollout management — from kick\-off through adoption, sign\-off, and handover — ensuring every phase lands on time and to a measurable outcome
* Codify the method after each deployment so the next one requires less ramp\-up


**Requirements**
* A track record of owning real outcomes — you have moved a P\&L or shipped a transformation, not just advised on one
* CEO\-room presence: ability to sit across from a mid\-market CEO as a peer and earn organisational trust quickly
* Technically literate enough to prototype, spec work, and direct engineers — you shape the solution, you don't wait for one
* You thrive in ambiguity — operating effectively with incomplete information, shifting requirements, and no fixed playbook
* Willing and energised to be on\-site with clients (:30\-60% travel)
* Likely background: top\-tier strategy firm (Engagement Manager → Associate Partner) or a proven in\-house transformation operator
* Hands\-on experience with AI / data tooling is a strong plus


**Benefits**
* Compensation: A competitive base calibrated to your market and seniority, plus a performance bonus tied to delivered outcomes
* Equity: Meaningful, founder\-tier ownership — this is the real upside, and it's sized to match
* Authority: Real decision rights and an interim\-executive mandate inside the client where granted. You own the result
* Trajectory: A portfolio of marquee CEO relationships and a clear path to Regional GM for MENA
* Location: On\-site with the client during deployment (:30\-60% travel across the MENA region); your home base is flexible
* Why AI makes this seat more valuable, not less: Valis automates the coordination, reporting and status layer of a company. This role sits on the other side of that line: CEO trust, judgment under ambiguity, and accountability for a real outcome are exactly what don't automate. As the platform gets stronger, the seat compounds in leverage — it doesn't erode


 We appreciate your interest in our job opportunities and our company. Our team carefully evaluates each application to identify the most suitable candidates for the role. Due to the high volume of applications received, we may not be able to respond to every applicant. However, if your qualifications align with our requirements, we will contact you to discuss the next steps in the selection process.

 The Senior Director will work across Strategy, Development, Finance, Operational Readiness, Commercial, and third\-party operators to optimise performance, govern operator delivery, and ensure QIC retains control over revenue strategy, programming, customer experience, partnerships, brand positioning, and long\-term value creation across the equestrian racecourse asset.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

* Strategic Leadership:
* Lead the owner\-side asset management strategy for the equestrian racecourse asset in alignment with QIC's objectives, pre\-opening priorities, and long\-term value creation agenda
* Define strategic objectives, commercial frameworks, and operating principles for race days, equestrian events, training, hospitality, ancillary activation, and non\-event utilisation
* Support operator selection, business plan challenge, and operating model development to ensure QIC retains decision\-making authority over key commercial, customer, and brand levers
* Relationship Management:
* Build and maintain effective relationships with internal stakeholders, third\-party operators, advisors, governing bodies, event promoters, and commercial partners
* Act as the key owner\-side point of contact on operational, commercial, and asset performance matters for the equestrian racecourse asset
* Ensure strong collaboration across Development, Strategy, Finance, and Operational Readiness to integrate asset management requirements through design, mobilisation, and pre\-opening
* Performance Monitoring:
* Oversee operator performance for the equestrian racecourse asset, ensuring delivery against contractual obligations, KPIs, SLAs, and QIC strategic objectives
* Establish and monitor performance dashboards covering revenue, profitability, utilisation, attendance, race day delivery, customer experience, equine welfare, safety, compliance, and readiness milestones
* Lead regular performance reviews, audits, and corrective action plans to drive continuous improvement and protect long\-term value
* Financial Oversight:
* Review and challenge operator business plans, budgets, and forecasts to ensure commercial robustness and alignment with owner expectations
* Drive achievement of financial targets, with a focus on sustainable revenue growth, EBITDA delivery, and efficient asset utilisation
* Analyse operating data and financial results to identify upside opportunities, performance risks, and value enhancement initiatives
* Support reporting and recommendations for executive stakeholders on asset performance, commercial outlook, and investment implications
* Customer Experience:
* Champion best\-in\-class customer experience across race days, equestrian events, hospitality, premium offerings, and venue journeys
* Ensure customer experience requirements are embedded into operator mobilisation, design\-stage input, and readiness planning
* Monitor customer satisfaction and guest performance metrics, ensuring experiences are safe, distinctive, and brand\-consistent
* Support service standards across permanent operations and major equestrian event periods
* Commercial, Marketing and Partnerships:
* Work with internal and external stakeholders to optimise revenue, sponsorship, partnerships, branding, and ancillary monetisation across the equestrian racecourse asset
* Shape event calendar strategy and utilisation plans to maximise visitation, yield, market positioning, and repeat demand
* Monitor market trends, benchmark competing racecourses and equestrian venues, and identify strategic growth opportunities
* Team Leadership:
* Build and lead a high\-performing owner\-side equestrian asset management capability aligned with asset priorities and mobilisation requirements
* Coordinate closely with operator teams while avoiding duplication of delivery roles and ensuring QIC capability and institutional knowledge are strengthened over time
* Mentor team members and foster a high\-performance, commercially focused asset management culture
* Provide owner\-side leadership on mobilisation, governance, and escalation of key risks and decisio


**Requirements**
 Bachelor's degree in business, finance, real estate, sport management, hospitality, equine management, or a related discipline.
   

  

 Strong experience in equestrian, racecourse, venues, entertainment, leisure, or major event asset management and operations.
   

  

 Experience in pre\-opening, operator mobilisation, business planning, and owner\-side governance of complex destination assets.
   

  

 Relevant professional certifications or memberships in asset management, project management, finance, hospitality, sports management, or equestrian\-related disciplines are preferred.
   

  

 10\+ years of relevant experience in asset management, venue operations, equestrian, sports, entertainment, leisure, or related sectors.
   

  

 5\+ years in a leadership role with accountability for commercial performance, operator oversight, or major asset delivery.
   

  

 Experience in the GCC or wider MENA region preferred, with demonstrated ability to operate in complex, high\-growth development environments

data.jd_text:
**Description:** 
 The WADPM shall develop, revise, and maintain an airfield driving program to ensure the safe operations of vehicles, aircraft, and pedestrian movement on and around the airfield environment IAW DAFI 13\-213,
 *Airfield Driving* 
 . The WADPM shall solicit help from base senior leadership and other various base support agencies to ensure the program is effectively implemented and managed. The WADPM shall provide all initial and recurring airfield drivers’ training for all unit level Airfield Driving Program Manager (ADPMs) and all airfield drivers. The WADPM will ensure reporting of Controlled Movement Area Violations and other significant events in Amentum’s MIS system, to appropriate Wing leadership, and as required in DAFMAN 13\-204 and DAFI 13\-213\. The WADPM will conduct spot checks to enforce and monitor compliance with airfield driving procedures.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**
* Must have a \*7\-skill level from an approved DoD institution or civilian equivalent.
* Have documented knowledge or experience with ICAO procedures. Have a minimum of 1 year experience implementing airfield safety procedures and generating and facilitating airfield flight line drivers program.
* Ability to coordinate with Wing Safety, Airfield Management, Airfield Operations, and tenant units.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for program documentation, briefings, and incident reporting.
* Familiarity with airfield operations, ATC radio phraseology, airfield risk management, and airfield safety programs.
* Ability to obtain/maintain a US Secret Clearance (Note: US Citizenship is required to obtain/maintain the clearance)


**Primary Duties and Responsibilities:**
* Serve as the Wing’s designated Airfield Driving Program Manager, responsible for the full lifecycle of the Airfield Driving Program.
* Develop, maintain, and update the Wing Airfield Driving Instruction (ADI), training and testing materials, and local operating procedures.
* Train unit ADPMs and certify them to administer, test and train personnel assigned to their unit.
* Conduct initial, recurring, and remedial airfield driving training, including classroom instruction, practical evaluations and competency assessments.
* Maintain program records, training logs, violation reports, and certification documentation in accordance with DoD and USAF requirements
* Manage the issuance, tracking, and revocation of Airfield Driving Licenses, ensuring compliance with DAFI 13\-213 and local directives.
* Oversee the Runway Incursion Prevention Program, including trend analysis, corrective actions, and coordination with Wing Safety
* Lead investigations for airfield driving violations, runway incursions, and safety incidents; develop corrective action plans and report findings to Airfield Management leadership.
* Conduct program audits of individual unit programs, spot checks, and unit compliance inspections to ensure adherence to airfield driving standards.
* Provide recurring briefings to Wing leadership on program status, compliance issues, and risk mitigation measures.

data.jd_text:
**Company Description** 




  





 ITALCONSULT, founded in Rome in 1957, is a renowned Italian engineering consulting firm with a legacy of delivering exceptional expertise in specialized engineering solutions. Supported by Bevilacqua Engineering Group, Intesa Sanpaolo S.p.A., and Tecnoinvestimenti Srl, ITALCONSULT is deeply involved in the development of transportation infrastructure, water, environment, energy, and civil structures. The company's extensive experience includes managing construction costs exceeding $12 billion over the last decade. ITALCONSULT plays a key role in social\-economic growth, delivering strategically integrated services across various sectors globally, with a focus on infrastructure and sustainable development.
 



  





**Role Description** 




  





**Job Title: Construction Director Residential** 




**Department:** 
 Construction Department
 



**Location:** 
 Riyadh
 



**Reporting to:** 
 Program Director
 



**Responsible for:** 
 Sr. Construction Manager / Construction Manager
 



  





**Job Summary** 




 The Construction Director serves as the overall lead for all construction management activities within the construction packages assigned to him under PMC\#4a. He ensures the effective execution of Diriyah Company’s construction strategy, aligning all project packages, stakeholders, and supervision consultants towards timely, safe, and quality project delivery.
 



 As part of the senior management team, the incumbent holds the responsibility to liaise and coordinate with the Program Director and the rest of the senior management team/peers with all matters related to operational issues required for the success of the program in accordance with the client expectations.
 



 As part of the team, the incumbent also holds the responsibility to assist in the setting, implementing, monitoring, and reporting of all required management reports and KPIs for the particular department in accordance to the program’s procedures.
 



  





**Key  Responsibilities  and  Specific  Accountabilities:** 




*(Results  this  role  is  expected  to  accomplish)* 




  
 



 · Manage and control the construction delivery process across various contractors and supervision teams, ensuring integrated execution of construction activities, efficient resource utilization, and adherence to Diriyah’s construction standards and milestone targets.
 



 ·  Lead and oversee all construction activities across the assigned plot/assets.
 



 ·  Represent the PMC as the point of contact for Diriyah Company regarding construction and delivery progress.
 



 ·  Ensure compliance with Diriyah’s Programme Management Plan (PMP), procedures, and quality/HSE standards.
 



 · Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define project scopes, budgets, timelines, and deliverables while adhering to safety and regulatory requirements.
 



 · Direct and coordinate Senior Construction Managers, Construction Managers, and Logistics teams.
 



 · Approve and oversee project execution plans, construction methodologies, and contractor phasing strategies.
 



 · Review monthly progress, cost, and risk reports; ensure early identification of construction issues.
 



 · Drive coordination between Design, Commercial, and Project Controls functions to manage construction related changes and mitigate claims.
 



 · Ensure compliance with FIDIC\-based Engineer’s duties as delegated to PMC under DC\-Contracts (The Role of the Engineer).
 



 · Lead stakeholder management and interface coordination with adjacent contractors, infrastructure PMCs, and supervision consultants.
 



 · Chair high\-level construction progress and coordination meetings and report to the Programme Director and Diriyah Company senior management.
 



 · Oversee the selection and management of subcontractors, ensuring compliance with contract terms and performance standards.
 



 · Conduct regular site visits to monitor progress, identify potential issues, and implement corrective actions as necessary.
 



 · Foster a culture of continuous improvement by promoting innovative construction techniques and technologies.
 



 · Mentor and develop construction staff, promoting career growth and knowledge sharing within the team.
 



 · Ensure compliance with all safety, health, and environmental regulations, fostering a safe working environment for all personnel.
 



  





**﻿Person Specification – Job Knowledge / Education and Qualifications / Personal Attributes:** 




 The ideal candidate should hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or Architecture (or equivalent). To be successful at this role, the candidate should have not less than 20 years of relevant experience, including at least 12 years in similar projects and minimum 5 years regional experience.  The candidate must have excellent communication skills and should have managed a multi\-cultural work force.
 



 Fluency in English is mandatory.
 



 Extensive knowledge of MS Office, PowerPoint, Adobe Acrobat, Primavera P6 for planning and reporting, with familiarity in Aconex, Autodesk Construction Cloud, BIM, and other project management, engineering, and coordination software.

Riyadh Air (RX), headquartered in the Saudi Capital, is the new national airline that’s shaping the future of flying.  Are you ready to shape the learning architecture of our digitally native airline and its workforce?
   

  

 We are seeking a visionary and commercially astute Director of Talent Development to lead our enterprise\-wide Learning \& Development strategy thereby building a future ready, safety centered and high\-performing organisation.
   

  

 Yours is a role responsible for building a future\-ready workforce that strengthens safety, performance, and long\-term growth. You are expected to oversee high\-impact learning delivery using blended, digital, simulation\-based, and experiential methods tailored to aviation.
   

  

 Partnering closely with senior leaders, you will ensure leadership depth, regulatory compliance, and workforce readiness across all functions.
   

  

 Importantly, your remit includes integrating leadership development, safety/compliance learning, operational training, and digital capability building into a unified enterprise framework. Further, you will design and implement a fully integrated airline learning ecosystem spanning safety, regulatory, operational, leadership, and digital capabilities.
   

  

 Central to your success in this role is the ability to own and manage the Talent Development budget, ensuring strategic ROI. Moreover, you will t rack and report KPIs including bench strength, capability readiness, and program effectiveness.
   

  

 You will also ensure regulatory alignment with key aviation bodies including the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO), International Air Transport Association (IATA) and the General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA), integrating compliance requirements into enterprise learning frameworks and operational governance.
   

  

 If you are passionate about building future\-ready leaders, strengthening safety culture, and shaping capability at scale, we invite you to lead the next chapter of our talent journey.

 Degree qualified, you will demonstrate a minimum of 10 years of sound leadership experience within an L\&D or Talent Development capacity interpreting strategy and policy in order to set and deliver objectives within the medium to long term.
   

  

 We’d love to hear from you even more if you are a bilingual Saudi national with proven leadership experience.
   

  

 This is your opportunity to shape the future of air travel. Bring your best and show us why you can own this position within Riyadh Air.

**About Us**
 With offices in 152 countries and nearly 328,000 professionals, we are one of the world’s leading professional services networks, helping organisations and individuals create lasting value through Assurance, Tax and Advisory services. For over 40 years, we have contributed to the Middle East’s transformation journey, partnering with governments and businesses to deliver sustainable solutions. Today, more than 12,000 of us across Bahrain, Egypt, Iraq, Jordan, Kuwait, Lebanon, Libya, Oman, Palestine, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and the UAE are shaping the region's future.
   

  

**Line Of Service Overview**
 At PwC Consulting, we lead with insight and deliver with purpose. You’ll work alongside experts across industries to design and deliver forward\-looking solutions in areas such as strategy and enterprise transformation, operational excellence, digital innovation, cyber resilience, and risk management. Our reimagined operating model brings together sector\-aligned, solution\-led teams empowered to move fast, think boldly, and create real impact. Whether transforming finance, enabling digital change, or shaping national visions, you’ll be part of a collaborative, forward\-thinking community, built to grow with you and the world around us.
   

  

**Business Unit Overview**
 As part of the Management Consulting team, you’ll shape how organizations operate, perform, and grow. We deliver end\-to\-end consulting solutions across Finance Transformation, Accounting Transformation, Workforce Transformation, Supply Chain \& Efficiency Transformation, Enterprise Solutions and capability building through PwC Academy. It’s where business performance meets human potential, backed by technology, powered by purpose.
   

  

**How You’ll Contribute**
 As a Director in Workforce Transformation dedicated to the Financial Services sector, based in Saudi Arabia, you’ll work as part of a team of problem solvers, helping to solve complex business issues from strategy to execution. Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
   

  

**Clients, Market \& Business Development**
* Client Relationship Management: Cultivate and manage executive\-level relationships in the Financial Services sector in KSA (including banks, insurance companies, development funds, sovereign wealth funds, market authorities \& regulators, asset \& wealth management etc.), ensuring alignment between workforce strategies and organizational priorities while addressing challenges with agility and insight.
* Business Development: Shape new Workforce Transformation offerings and identify growth opportunities in the Financial Services sector, collaborating across service lines to build integrated solutions that elevate our market presence and client impact.
+ Define and drive the go\-to\-market strategy for Workforce Transformation in the Financial Services sector, including priority clients, target accounts, propositions and pipeline build plans in KSA
+ Lead independent origination (non\-RfP/ sole sourced) of complex workforce transformation opportunities by engaging C\-suite and senior buyers, understanding their operational and transformation challenges in the Financial Services sector shaping outcome\-led propositions.
+ Support the end\-to\-end pursuit lifecycle from qualification through proposal, deal shaping, negotiation and closing
+ Build market presence and credibility for the Workforce Transformation proposition in the Financial Services sector across KSA and Middle East


**Projects and Program Delivery**
* Project Leadership: Oversee high\-impact transformation programs (often multiple projects / programs simultaneously) with Financial Services sector clients in KSA across multiple Workforce Transformation consulting services. including but not limited to:
* Operating model and organizational design
* Strategic and operational workforce planning
* Performance management and total rewards
* Competency/Skills framework development, talent assessment and upskilling, leadership development, talent management
* HR functional effectiveness (HR operating model, HR policies practices \& procedures, HR process re\-engineering, AI used cases in HR, intelligent automation in HR, HR technologies etc.)
* Change management, culture, employee engagement and employee experience


**Team Development**
* Team / Coachee Development: Coach and mentor team members on projects or those assigned outside of project on capabilities, supporting their professional growth through structured feedback, skills development planning, and continuous performance guidance.


**What You’ll Bring**
* Bachelor’s degree in related field; Master’s preferred
* 12\-15 years' experience in Workforce Transformation / Human Capital / Organization Effectiveness consulting with at least 6 years in the Financial Services sector.
* Proven experience independently delivering:
+ Commercial and business performance within KSA; a strong network in the Kingdom within the Financial Services sector preferred
+ Large\-scale Workforce Transformation projects and leading teams of 5 – 6 project team members

* Fundamental understanding of business and operational aspects of the Banking \& Financial Services industry
* Deep technical abilities in Workforce Transformation consulting services
* Self\-starter/entrepreneurial mindset
* Collaborative mindset to work effectively across functions and foster inclusive team dynamics
* Excellent command of English and Arabic, both written and verbal


**How You’ll Make a Difference**
 At PwC Middle East, we expect all our people to embody the skills and behaviours of The PwC Professional framework, helping us deliver on our strategy while growing and developing as leaders at every level.
   

  

**Why You’ll Love Working at PwC**
 At PwC Middle East, you’ll find more than just a job – you’ll build a meaningful career, supported by rewards and benefits that help you thrive. We offer competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and programs that promote well\-being, balance, and personal growth. You’ll have access to continuous learning, digital upskilling, and a collaborative environment that values innovation, mentorship, and diversity. Discover more about Life at PwC Middle East .

data.jd_text:
**About The Role**
 At Qiddiya Investment Company, we are shaping a landmark destination redefining entertainment, culture and hospitality in the Kingdom. The Hospitality Business Unit is developing a portfolio of hotel assets central to this vision. As these assets progress, we are seeking experienced professionals to help deliver them to the highest standards of design quality, guest experience and commercial performance.
   

  

 In this role, you will lead the end\-to\-end development of hospitality assets, from concept and business case through to delivery. You will shape development strategy, guide critical decisions and ensure assets deliver distinctive guest experiences, strong commercial performance and long\-term value for both the asset and across the wider destination. Working across key stakeholders and interfaces, you will drive alignment, manage complexity and ensure assets are commercially robust and in line with Qiddiya's vision and development objectives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the strategic development of hospitality assets from early\-stage briefing through to delivery, handover and operational readiness
* Shape asset strategy, feasibility and business plans to define positioning, guest experience and value creation
* Drive cross\-functional alignment across strategy, asset management, design, delivery and Operators to ensure seamless progression from development through to operations
* Ensure assets align with Qiddiya's vision and quality benchmarks, delivering best\-in\-class design and guest experience
* Provide strategic oversight of key asset decisions, including positioning, room mix, amenities, guest experience and operational planning to maximise differentiation and portfolio performance
* Lead key asset validation milestones, including mock\-up rooms reviews and critical gateway decisions, balancing Operator, design, commercial and delivery requirements
* Proactively manage interfaces, risks and opportunities across all development workstreams to protect value and maintain delivery momentum
* Lead governance and executive reporting processes, clearly articulating asset strategy, development priorities, risks and recommendations in key forums
* Mentor, guide and develop teams, embedding strong development capability and best\-practice approaches across the portfolio


**Requirements**
**Skills \& Attributes Required**
* Experience shaping development strategy, feasibility and positioning
* Strong commercial acumen and understanding of value creation
* Strong judgement in complex, high\-value development environments
* Ability to manage complexity across stakeholders, workstreams and project stages
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive key decisions through clear communication and storytelling
* Comfortable operating in fast\-paced environments, managing ambiguity and shifting priorities
* Proficiency in project management and reporting tools (e.g. Aconex etc.)


**Preferred Background \& Experience**
* Proven track record delivering complex assets (e.g. luxury hospitality, mixed\-use)
* Experience developing hospitality assets with Operator engagement (selection, onboarding or alignment)
* Experience across full development lifecycle from feasibility through delivery and handover
* Experience working within multi\-stakeholder, large\-scale destination or master planned environments
* GCC experience preferred


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Real Estate Development, Architecture, Engineering or related discipline


**Professional Certifications (if Required)**
* Professional membership or recognised certification preferred (e.g. RICS, RIBA, PMP or equivalent)


**Years Of Experience**
* 15\+ years' experience in real estate or hospitality development

**Job Description**
 We are seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion ERP Project Manager to lead end\-to\-end ERP transformation programs; experience across different sectors is considered an advantage. The role will be responsible for managing Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP implementations across multiple workstreams, ensuring successful delivery from planning and design through deployment, cutover, hypercare, and operational stabilization.
   

  

 The Project Manager will oversee project governance, stakeholder and vendor management, risk and resource management, testing, data migration, release management, and organizational change activities, while ensuring alignment with business objectives and operational requirements
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Lead full lifecycle Oracle Fusion ERP implementation programs.
* Manage project scope, schedule, budget, risks, dependencies, and delivery governance.
* Oversee cutover planning, go\-live execution, hypercare, and coexistence strategy.
* Manage environment and instance planning, release management, and testing governance.
* Coordinate data migration, reconciliation, and business readiness activities.
* Lead stakeholder engagement, vendor management, and executive reporting.
* Ensure compliance with PMO governance and telecom industry standards.
* Support organizational change management, training, and user adoption activities.


**Qualifications**
* 12\+ years of experience in project and program management, with a proven track record of leading complex transformation initiatives.
* Strong hands\-on experience in Oracle Corporation Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP implementations.
* Proven experience managing large\-scale ERP transformation programs across multiple sectors and enterprise environments.
* Strong knowledge of Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery methodologies, with the ability to adapt delivery approaches based on project needs.
* Extensive expertise in ERP governance, cutover planning and execution, testing management, data migration, risk management, and stakeholder engagement.


**Preferred Certifications:**
* Project Management Professional (PMP)
* PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI\-ACP)
* Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or equivalent Scrum certification
* SAFe
* Oracle Cloud ERP Certification
* ITIL
* COBIT
