data.jd_text:
**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Purpose Summary**
 The incumbent will lead in a proactive and prudent fashion the Bank’s treasury function by managing the Bank’s cash flows, asset – liability profile and foreign exchange exposures/risk and generate supplementary income within the set strategy, risk appetite, applicable regulatory limits and approved products.
   

  

 Manages activity of the trading team by implementing the defined Group Risk Management Framework in which they operate. Develops and actively pursues cross\-border trading opportunities and developing a strategy to grow the business. Has thorough knowledge of a broad range of trading techniques including trading/hedging strategies (stack and roll, cross commodity), market liquidity and volatility, options, derivatives, futures, swaps, exotics pricing and trading, and has broad understanding of commodity markets. Has extensive background in risk management strategies and is responsible for ensuring that overall value and risk exposure of the trading portfolio remains within the agreed Group strategy.
   

  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities By Dimensions**
* Oversees the development and implementation of annual business plans and target budgets for units of responsibility with emphasis on achievement of set targets/ objectives, business growth and expansion; in accordance with the Bank’s overall budget and strategy.
* Act within the limits of the powers delegated to the incumbent and delegate activities/ authority to the respective staff as required and monitor exercise of the same.
* Approves formulated, and/or specific strategies which cover balance sheet asset, liability and contingent allocation, longer term funding arrangements asset diversification, use of market products and financial instruments with risks identified, and hedging, trading and investment strategies.
* Oversees the implementation and evaluation of the Treasury strategic and business development plans and achievement of related short and long term business goals both locally and internationally.
* Approves Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) created for the purpose of performance monitoring and quality measurement purposes for the Treasury function and monitor their achievements on periodic basis.
* Implements KPI’s and best practices for role
* Promote cost consciousness and efficiency and enhance productivity, to minimise cost, avoid waste, and optimise benefits for the bank.
* Demonstrate clear understanding of the important factors behind the bank's financial \& non\-financial performance.
* Approves Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with internal departments/ units to achieve improvements in turnaround time (TAT) which will also help increase external customer satisfaction.
* Provide timely and accurate information to the external and internal auditors, the Compliance function, and Group Risk as and when required.
* Meets with visiting banks representatives, and maintains credit lines and services through active relationship management.
* Establishes and oversees the management of relationships with key internal and external stakeholders and managing key client interface.
* Provide feedback to Corporate/Retail Banking business units’ managers and, as appropriate, recommend course of action.
* To assist customers in all their queries on Bank’s product and seek solution to their requests
* Maintain activities in accordance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with internal departments/ units to achieve improvements in turn\-around time.
* Build and maintain strong and effective relationship with all other related departments and units to achieve the Group’s goals/objectives.
* Provide timely and accurate information to the external and internal auditors and the Compliance function as and when required.


**Education/Experience Requirements**
* University graduate preferably with a Major in Finance, Banking, Economics, or Mathematics (related field of study), Masters preferred.
* MBA, CFA, ACT or related professional certification is preferable.
* 15 years diverse Treasury experience, of which 5 years must have been in a leading role in a Treasury Division, preferably in the country or with an international bank.
* Additional commercial banking experience, especially credit and market risk management would be of value.


 Note: you will be required to attach the following:
   

  

* Resume/CV

data.jd_text:
**Purpose / Mission:**
 Develop, integrate and maintain the project's master schedule across all phases from pre\-FID through commissioning of the 2\.5 Mtpa green Direct Reduced Iron (DRI) / Hot Briquetted Iron (HBI) plant in Duqm, Oman. Provide the Project Director, the company executive and the project's lenders with the integrated schedule view that supports decision\-making, risk management and financial close.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Develop and maintain the project's master schedule, integrating inputs from the technology licensor, the integrated delivery partner, equipment vendors, utility providers, port authorities and Omani regulatory counterparties.
* Consume and integrate the technology licensor's pre\-engineering Level 2 schedule and the integrated delivery partner's FEED and execution schedules into a single owner's master schedule.
* Manage interface dates and critical path dependencies across engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, utility connections, port readiness and regulatory approvals.
* Maintain the project schedule baseline and track progress against baseline through earned value or equivalent reporting methods.
* Lead schedule risk analysis, including critical path analysis, float consumption tracking, and schedule contingency assessment.
* Prepare schedule reports for internal review, lender reporting and external stakeholder engagement, including the Project Director, the company executive, the lender consortium, and equity investors.
* Support the project's cost estimate development by providing schedule\-driven inputs into resource and cost loading.
* Support the project's risk management process by identifying schedule risks and supporting mitigation planning.
* Provide planning support to the discipline lead engineers in their interactions with the integrated delivery partner and equipment vendors.
* Maintain alignment between the project schedule and the project's regulatory, permitting and contractual milestones.


**Requirements / Skills / Experience:**
* Minimum 12 years' experience in project planning and scheduling on large heavy industrial capital projects, with at least one project of capex value USD 500 million or above.
* Direct experience on greenfield projects in steel, ironmaking, petrochemical, oil and gas, fertilizer or power.
* Demonstrated experience integrating multi\-party schedules across owner, technology licensor, EPC contractors and equipment vendors.
* Strong understanding of critical path methodology, schedule risk analysis and earned value management.
* Proficiency in industry\-standard scheduling software (Primavera P6 required; MS Project an advantage).

 Develop, validate and maintain the project's capital cost estimate across the pre\-FID and FEED phases of the 2\.5 Mtpa green Direct Reduced Iron (DRI) / Hot Briquetted Iron (HBI) plant in Duqm, Oman, to a level of accuracy sufficient to support Final Investment Decision and lender due diligence. Provide independent owner\-side cost estimating, quantity surveying and commercial assurance across the technology package, the integrated delivery partner's scope, and the broader project capex.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Develop and maintain the project's capital cost estimate, integrating inputs from the technology licensor, the integrated delivery partner, equipment vendors, port and utility infrastructure providers, and the owner's team.
* Triangulate, challenge and validate cost estimates produced by the technology licensor and the integrated delivery partner, providing independent owner\-side commercial assurance.
* Develop and maintain the project's bill of quantities for civil, structural, mechanical, piping and electrical scopes within the owner's review responsibility. Lead cost estimating accuracy improvement from order\-of\-magnitude through Class 3 to Class 2 estimates aligned with AACE International recommended practice and lender expectations.
* Support the project's procurement strategy by developing should\-cost analyses, market price benchmarks and cost\-driver analyses for major equipment and construction packages.
* Maintain the project's cost contingency framework, including identification of cost risks, quantification of contingency requirements and reporting against contingency drawdown.
* Support the project's value engineering process by quantifying cost impacts of design alternatives and providing commercial input into engineering trade\-off decisions.
* Support project finance lender due diligence by preparing cost estimate documentation packages and engaging directly with independent cost consultants engaged by the lender consortium.
* Provide cost reporting to the Project Director, the company executive and external stakeholders including lenders and equity investors.
* Support post\-FID cost control and change management by establishing the cost baseline, change control framework and earned value reporting structure.

* Direct experience on greenfield projects in steel, ironmaking, petrochemical, oil and gas, fertilizer or power.
* Demonstrated experience providing independent owner\-side cost validation against contractor or licensor cost estimates.
* Familiarity with FIDIC\-based contracting, lump\-sum cost build\-ups, and reimbursable cost frameworks.
* Experience supporting project finance lender due diligence on cost estimate deliverables is strongly preferred.
* Middle East or GCC project delivery experience strongly preferred. Prior experience in Oman is an advantage.
* Strong analytical and reporting skills, with the ability to communicate cost status and risk to senior executive and lender audiences.
* Ability to work within a small owner's team where each individual carries direct responsibility for their function.
* This position is open to Omani nationals only.


**Required Education / Qualification / Training:**
* Bachelor's degree in Quantity Surveying, Cost Engineering, Construction Management, Engineering or related discipline (required).
* Master's degree in Cost Engineering, Project Management or related field (preferred).
* Member of the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors (MRICS) or AACE International Certified Cost Professional (CCP) (preferred).

data.title: Asset Manager
data.raw_snippet:
**JOB PURPOSE** 




 The Asset Manager is responsible for maximizing the value, financial performance, and long\-term sustainability of Grand Blue City's portfolio of assets across multiple asset classes, including residential, commercial, hospitality, retail, entertainment, industrial, infrastruct
data.jd_text:
**JOB PURPOSE** 




 The Asset Manager is responsible for maximizing the value, financial performance, and long\-term sustainability of Grand Blue City's portfolio of assets across multiple asset classes, including residential, commercial, hospitality, retail, entertainment, industrial, infrastructure, and mixed\-use developments.
 



  





 The role acts as the owner’s representative throughout the asset lifecycle, overseeing business performance, revenue optimization, operational efficiency, capital planning, leasing strategies, investment returns, and stakeholder management. The Asset Manager is accountable for asset\-level and portfolio\-level P\&L performance, ensuring assets achieve their strategic, financial, and operational objective.
 



  





**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**




**Asset Performance \& P\&L Management** 



* Assume full responsibility for asset\-level financial performance and profitability.
* Develop and manage annual business plans, operating budgets, and financial forecasts.
* Monitor revenue, operating expenses, EBITDA, NOI, cash flow, and asset valuation metrics.
* Identify and implement initiatives to improve asset profitability and value creation.
* Conduct regular financial and operational performance reviews and recommend corrective actions where necessary.
* Establish performance targets and KPIs for individual assets and portfolio segments.



**Portfolio Management** 



* Manage a diverse portfolio of real estate and infrastructure assets across various asset classes.
* Develop portfolio optimization strategies to maximize risk\-adjusted returns.
* Evaluate asset hold, repositioning, redevelopment, refinancing, acquisition, and disposal opportunities.
* Monitor market trends, competitive positioning, and emerging opportunities affecting portfolio performance.
* Support strategic portfolio planning and capital allocation decisions.



**Commercial \& Revenue Optimization** 



* Lead initiatives to enhance revenue generation and asset utilization.
* Oversee leasing performance, tenant mix strategies, occupancy optimization, and rental growth initiatives.
* Assess commercial opportunities including new revenue streams, partnerships, sponsorships, and ancillary income.
* Work closely with leasing, sales, hospitality, and operations teams to maximize asset performance.



**Business Planning \& Investment Analysis** 



* Prepare detailed financial models and investment analyses.
* Conduct feasibility assessments for capital improvements, redevelopment projects, and strategic initiatives.
* Evaluate investment returns using NPV, IRR, ROI, payback, and other financial metrics.
* Support acquisition, divestment, and restructuring decisions through comprehensive financial and commercial assessments.



**Capital Projects \& Asset Enhancement** 



* Identify asset enhancement opportunities to improve value, customer experience, and operational performance.
* Oversee capital expenditure planning and prioritization.
* Monitor implementation of approved enhancement projects and track return on investment.
* Coordinate with development and project management teams to ensure alignment with asset strategies



**Operations Oversight** 



* Collaborate with property management, facilities management, hospitality operators, and service providers.
* Monitor service standards, operational efficiency, customer satisfaction, and asset condition.
* Ensure assets are maintained to required quality, safety, and regulatory standards.
* Review operating contracts and service agreements to ensure value for money.



**Stakeholder Management** 



* Serve as the primary owner representative for assigned assets.
* Manage relationships with operators, tenants, investors, consultants, government entities, and strategic partners.
* Present asset performance reports and recommendations to executive management and boards.
* Facilitate alignment between asset strategy, operations, finance, and development teams.



**Governance, Risk \& Compliance** 



* Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, contractual obligations, and corporate governance requirements.
* Identify and mitigate operational, financial, and market risks.
* Maintain robust reporting, controls, and performance monitoring frameworks.
* Support internal and external audit requirements.



  





**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE**




  




* Bachelor’s degree in real estate, Finance, Investment, Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, or related discipline.
* Master's degree (MBA, Real Estate, Finance, or Investment Management) preferred.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in asset management, real estate investment, portfolio management, hospitality, infrastructure, or related sectors.
* Demonstrated experience managing diverse asset classes and complex stakeholder environments.
* Proven track record of delivering strong financial and operational performance.
* Experience with large\-scale mixed\-use developments and destination assets is highly desirable.

 We are a leading international law and professional services firm providing legal, corporate and fiduciary services to global corporations, financial institutions, capital market participants and investment fund managers. Diversity is our secret weapon – it’s the sheer breadth of Walkers people that makes us who we are – gathered from across the globe and fluent in languages, jurisdictions and cultures that help us to mirror our clients and keep our own thinking in tune with the world in which we operate.
   

  

**Overview Of Role**
 This role will ideally be based in either our Dubai, Hong Kong or Singapore office.
   

  

 We are keen to hear from qualified candidates in London who are open to relocating to Dubai, Hong Kong or Singapore.
   

  

 This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced compliance professional with a background in the legal or professional services sector to join a team dealing with conflicts of interest and client confidentiality matters.
   

  

 Reporting to our Director of Conflicts and joining the OGC team, the successful candidate will assist with the development of a specialised team of conflicts professionals responsible for analysing, advising on and resolving legal and commercial conflicts of interest, information barriers and share dealing requests. This is to ensure we comply with all applicable regulations, professional rules of conduct, contractual terms related to conflicts of interest and client confidentiality, and protect client relationships and our reputation.
   

  

 Our conflicts analysts assist with the resolution of complex conflicts issues, deal with sensitive confidential matters, and carry out conflict checks associated with share dealing requests and lateral hires into the business.
   

  

 The Senior Conflicts Manager will work closely with the Director of Conflicts on the ongoing development of our policies, controls and processes as they relate to conflicts of interest, client confidentiality, information barriers, share dealing and Market Abuse Regulations. This will include optimising our use of tech/automation (including
 *Intapp* 
 ), standardising and simplifying our policies and processes across the Walkers group, and building an optimal team shape that provides agility, efficiency, consistency and excellent service to the business and our clients.

* Day\-to\-day management of conflicts advisors within the relevant time zone (including leading the recruitment of additional conflicts advisors).
* Act as a point of escalation for the team and the business on all legal and commercial conflicts issues, analysing and resolving issues in accordance with applicable regulations, professional rules and Walkers' own policy and procedures.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across Walkers globally, acting as a point of contact in relation to all conflicts and client confidentiality queries and leading communications across the business in this area.
* Together with other senior team members, lead on internal training as it relates to conflicts of interest, client confidentiality, share dealing and insider lists.
* Identify any weaknesses or areas for potential improvement in our existing client onboarding system (Intapp Intake) and, working with the Director of Conflicts and the Compliance Business Systems team, recommend enhancements that streamline/simplify processes for team and the business, and/or strengthen our controls.
* Working with the Director of Conflicts and key stakeholders from across the business, develop and deliver a phased programme of work that: (i) rapidly enhances our conflicts offering/service delivery to the business (including through improved time zone coverage/capacity, responsiveness, efficiency and expertise); (ii) enables us to provide a fully centralised conflict checking/analysis function within the next two years.
* Support the Director of Conflicts in driving quality, consistency, service excellence, efficiency, proactivity and adaptability across the Conflicts team.
* Assist the Director of Conflicts in developing and leading people initiatives within the Conflicts team to drive development of expertise and skills, attraction and retention, and fostering a high\-performing, collaborative and open team culture.
* Input into regular reporting to senior management and/or other stakeholders as required.
* Participate in cross\-functional initiatives which impact or relate to conflicts of interest and client confidentiality.
* Keep abreast with developments in regulation, technology and the market which are relevant to conflicts of interest, client confidentiality, market abuse/insider trading, and information barriers.


**Education, Skills \& Experience**
* Bachelor's degree in law, business, finance or another relevant field.
* Experience in a compliance or in\-house legal role in an international law firm or professional services environment.
* Compliance expert with deep technical and practical knowledge of legal conflicts of interest, commercial conflicts and client confidentiality, with some knowledge of Market Abuse Regs.
* Familiarity with Intapp Intake.
* Experience of policy work.
* Experience of people management, including supervision/management of large teams and experience devising and driving people initiatives (including around recruitment and development).
* Proven track record of delivering change and process improvements.
* Experience working in an offshore environment or with offshore structures would be helpful but not required
* Strategic: ability to work in pursuit of a clear strategic direction, align the team's priorities with those of the wider OGC team and the firm, and proactively identify improvements.

 You will lead and develop a high\-performing organization, partnering across countries, functions, and commercial teams to expand Leica Biosystems’ market leadership, accelerate Digital Pathology adoption, and deliver sustainable growth across one of the most strategically important regions for the business.

data.jd_text:
KEO is a creative enterprise, where innovation is a way of life. We are uniquely resourced with end\-to\-end services to take clients from inspiration – through conceptualization – to realization of planning, design or project delivery in the built and natural environments. For over 60 years we’ve led with vision, contributing to many of the world’s most ambitious projects, iconic places, remarkable experiences and prosperous communities.
 



  





 As a highly integrated and agile AEP/PMCM firm, KEO is recognized by ENR as one of the Top 225 International Design Firms and one of the Top 20 International PM/CM Firms. We are also ranked by World Architecture as the 51st largest global architecture firm and the \#1 Firm in the Middle East Region in their 2024 WA100 Survey.
 



  





 We invite you to join us. Why?
 



  





 When you join KEO, you’ll discover more than just a job – you’ll find a supportive environment that fosters your professional development through internal global mobility and career development and does so within a culture that supports company\-wide health and well\-being through on\-demand counselling services and regular workplace clinics. You will be invited to celebrate community events such as sports days, fun\-runs, in\-house sports teams and beach clean ups. In addition to your competitive package and benefits you will have access to a suite of policies that include hybrid working arrangements, individual athletic sponsorship, study assistance sponsorship, employee referral rewards.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  





 Our newest opportunity is for a talented Cloud and Infrastructure Platforms Director to to join our award\-winning team based in Dubai, UAE.
 



  





 This critical leadership role is responsible for defining, delivering, and managing the organization’s enterprise cloud, infrastructure, and platform strategy across regional and international operations. The successful candidate will lead the modernization of IT infrastructure, cloud adoption, cybersecurity resilience, digital workplace technologies, and enterprise platform services to support a rapidly growing construction consultancy business.
 



  





 The role requires a highly experienced technology leader with a strong background in hybrid cloud environments, enterprise infrastructure operations, IT governance, cybersecurity, and large\-scale transformation initiatives within complex, multi\-site organizations.
 



  





 We envisage success in this role to include;
 



  





**Strategic \& Platform Leadership** 




  




* Define and execute KEO's cloud\-first, platform\-first infrastructure strategy, leading the evolution from traditional operations toward a modern platform engineering model that enables self\-service, automated, and product\-oriented infrastructure capabilities.
* Manage and continuously improve service reliability at enterprise scale, owning KEO's infrastructure performance and availability posture in alignment with digital transformation goals and business priorities.



  





**Cloud \& Platform Engineering** 




  




* Own and evolve KEO's Microsoft Azure environment, leading the design, deployment, and lifecycle management of IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS platforms through cloud\-native architectures, infrastructure\-as\-code (IaC), and platform engineering principles to ensure scalability, security, cost\-optimization, and developer agility.
* Oversee identity and access management via Microsoft Entra ID, enforcing MFA, RBAC, and least\-privilege principles, and manage KEO's zero\-trust network architecture ensuring access is granted only through verified identity, context, and policy.
* Maintain certified digital platforms \- including Microsoft SharePoint and Autodesk Construction Cloud \- to their respective security and governance standards.
* Drive cloud cost optimization initiatives \- including right\-sizing, reserved capacity management, and workload scheduling \- to maximize return on cloud investment.



  





**Cybersecurity \& Digital Trust** 




  




* Champion KEO's cybersecurity posture across all infrastructure and platform operations, overseeing Microsoft Sentinel (SIEM) for real\-time threat detection, automated response playbooks, and rapid incident management, alongside cloud security posture management (CSPM) for continuous assessment and remediation of misconfigurations and vulnerabilities.
* Ensure zero\-trust, least\-privilege, and access control governance principles are consistently applied and independently verified via EY audits, and lead KEO's phishing simulation programme to drive continuous improvements in security awareness.
* Maintain and continuously improve Business Continuity Planning (BCP) and Disaster Recovery (DR) programmes \- including automation of recovery workflows, regular testing, and audit\-readiness \- with appropriate escalation to IT leadership and executive oversight.



  





**Modern Service Management** 




  




* Lead a shift from traditional ITIL\-process orientation toward experience\-driven, outcome\-based service management, owning service reliability engineering practices including SLAs, SLOs, and error budgets across all platforms.
* Lead continuous service improvement cycles, platform lifecycle governance, and technology refresh programmes, ensuring all operations adhere to KEO's IT governance standards, security policies, regulatory requirements, and green IT sustainability commitments.



  





**Automation, DevOps \& SRE Mindset** 




  




* Champion an automation\-first culture, leading the implementation of infrastructure automation, CI/CD pipeline integration, self\-service cloud provisioning, and zero\-touch operations to eliminate manual processes at scale.
* Apply Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles \- including error budgets, reliability targets, and blameless post\-incident reviews \- to drive continuous improvement in platform deployment velocity, reliability, and recovery time.



  





**Data\-Driven \& AI\-Enabled Operations** 




  




* Lead the adoption of observability platforms and AIOps tooling to enable predictive performance monitoring, anomaly detection, and automated incident response, driving responsible AI adoption to enhance infrastructure efficiency, intelligent capacity planning, and proactive operations
* Use operational telemetry and data\-driven insights to inform platform investment decisions and continuous improvement initiatives, staying at the forefront of AI\-driven infrastructure operations and edge computing to evaluate and recommend adoption pathways aligned to KEO's strategy.



  





**Team Leadership \& People Development** 




  




* Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing, geographically distributed infrastructure team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning.
* Set clear goals, provide regular feedback, and champion professional growth and certification of each team member.
* Build a psychologically safe team environment where automation innovation, constructive challenge, and knowledge sharing are actively encouraged.
* Promote cross\-functional collaboration with Digital Workplace, Enterprise Digital Solutions, and Technology Strategy teams to ensure “one IT” delivery



  





**Qualifications** 




  





 To be successful in this dynamic opportunity, we envision that your career journey to date will include 10–15\+ years of progressive experience in enterprise IT infrastructure, including a minimum of 3–5 years in a leadership capacity managing teams, cloud platforms, or enterprise infrastructure operations. You will hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline, or possess an equivalent combination of education and over 10 years of relevant professional experience.
 



  




* Proven, hands\-on experience managing Microsoft Azure cloud environments at enterprise scale, including hybrid cloud architecture, identity, and security services.
* Demonstrated experience leading a shift from traditional infrastructure management to modern platform engineering and DevOps\-aligned operations.
* Strong expertise in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD for infrastructure, self\-service cloud provisioning, and zero\-touch operations.
* Experience applying Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles, including error budgets, SLOs, and blameless post\-incident review practices.
* Proven cloud financial management (FinOps) experience: cost optimization, chargeback models, consumption governance, and cloud cost dashboards.
* Deep expertise in cybersecurity operations: Microsoft Sentinel (SIEM), zero\-trust architecture, cloud security posture management (CSPM), Entra ID / Azure AD, and endpoint security.
* Experience managing third\-party governance and audit review processes.
* Familiarity with AI\-driven infrastructure operations, edge computing architectures, and platform product models.
* Experience in the AEC (Architecture, Engineering, and Construction) or professional services sector is advantageous.
* Understanding of sustainable/green IT infrastructure principles and their application to cloud operations.



  





 KEO’s performance is founded upon integrity, results, innovation, safety and our people. We embrace diversity and recognise its’ contribution to client success wherever we work.
 



  





 We are excited to hear how you can partner with our award\-winning team and treat all expressions of interest confidentially.

 Based in Dubai, the M\&A Integration Manager, operates in a fast\-paced environment, requiring close coordination with local operations teams, venue managers, and external partners to integrate processes without disrupting major exhibitions.
data.jd_text:
**Role Purpose and Strategic Mandate** 

  





 Based in Dubai, the M\&A Integration Manager, operates in a fast\-paced environment, requiring close coordination with local operations teams, venue managers, and external partners to integrate processes without disrupting major exhibitions. 
 



  





 Operating as the primary operational and technology contact at the deal level, this position is crucial to managing the unique public\-private joint venture landscape, requiring close coordination with the Dubai World Trade Centre (DWTC), local government authorities, and regional public\-sector partners.
 



  





**Functional Responsibilities** 




  





 The M\&A Integration Manager in Dubai is responsible for driving the hands\-on integration of systems, venues, and processes across the portfolio.
 


* **Integration Management Office Leadership:** 
 Mobilise cross\-functional teams, define integration milestones, manage local transition risks, and track synergies for regional events.
* **Central Governance Integration:** 
 Report progress, risks, and implementation barriers directly to the group\-level M\&A Technology Steering Board to ensure local joint venture activities align with global shared services (GBS).
* **Programmatic Oversight Boundary:** 
 Champion and govern the adoption of M\&A technology playbooks and best practices; note that this role focuses on operational planning and does not directly manage or configure the technical builds.
* **System Integration:** 
 Map and migrate local financial systems, billing engines, and exhibitor databases into the shared SAP and Oracle architectures.
* **Landing Architecture Mapping:** 
 Coordinate with Enterprise Architects and platform owners to define the transition and landing architectures required to migrate acquired business systems and legacy DWTC platforms onto the standardised technology stack.
* **Venue System Alignment:** 
 Coordinate with venue operations to align registration, ticketing, and event logistics systems at the flagship regional exhibition and venue centers.
* **Regional HR Compliance:** 
 Partner with the people team to transition employees, manage visa processes, and align payroll with UAE Labor Law.
* **Operational Continuity:** 
 Partner with event directors to ensure core systems remain fully operational during major exhibition cycles.
* **Tax \& Treasury Control:** 
 Partner with local finance teams to manage UAE VAT, corporate tax, and cross\-border payment structures.



  




**Requirements and Qualifications** 

  





 This position requires an integration specialist with experience managing corporate transformations within the Middle East.
 


* **Professional Experience:** 
 Minimum of 6 years of experience in M\&A integration, corporate restructuring, or operational PMO, preferably in the Middle East.
* **UAE Government \& Local Emirati Experience:** 
 Strong preference for UAE National (Emirati) candidates, or professionals with extensive, proven experience working with or within UAE Government departments and public\-sector entities.
* **ERP \& Local Systems:** 
 Hands\-on experience with SAP and Oracle financial modules, with a track record of standardising billing and procurement workflows.
* **Structured Mobilisation Planning:** 
 Demonstrated ability to create and manage detailed mobilisation plans, map complex target solutions, and secure alignment on options, trade\-offs, and financial run\-costs with senior leadership.
* **Regional HR Knowledge:** 
 Good understanding of UAE Labor Law, free\-zone employment rules, and payroll processing in the GCC region.
* **Events Sector Insight:** 
 Experience working within the live events, hospitality, or exhibitions sector in the Middle East.
* **Bilingual Capability:** 
 Professional fluency in English is required; professional proficiency in Arabic is highly desirable.
* **Soft Skills:** 
 Excellent cross\-cultural communication skills, resilience, and the ability to manage stakeholder interests in a joint venture.

 From the projects you will work on to the clients we work with. From career\-defining opportunities to an inclusive and diverse practice where we all contribute to a more equitable world. From our reputation to our relationships. Wherever your Buro Happold career takes you, it’ll be anything but ordinary.
   

  

**Your next role**
 Buro Happold has a clear strategic plan, strong learning culture and entrepreneurial mindset that will allow you to thrive.
   

  

 You’ll be part of something bigger than us all where sustainability, equity, social and performance outcomes matter. All of Buro Happold is committed to doing the right thing, even when that’s the hardest thing. This is a genuine opportunity to make impact \- and leave real legacy.
   

  

**Your key duties**
 Saudi Arabia is entering a delivery‑led phase in which large portfolios of urban, social and economic infrastructure assets are moving into their operational phase, requiring robust operating models, governance, and performance management frameworks. Buro Happold is uniquely placed in this context, bringing decades of design and advisory experience on many of the Kingdom’s priority assets and programmes.
   

  

 In this role you will sit at the intersection of strategy, engineering and operations, helping clients to translate vision‑led masterplans and investment cases into practical, value‑for‑money operating solutions that work on the ground. You will play a visible part in shaping how major assets are operated, maintained and continually optimised to deliver desired outcomes over the long term.
   

  

 As Engagement Manager – Operations Advisory, you will lead multidisciplinary consulting engagements that help public and private clients in Saudi Arabia move from planning to delivery as major programmes and giga‑projects transition into their operational phase. Building on Buro Happold’s deep understanding of complex assets across sectors, you will shape and deliver integrated advisory projects that combine our capabilities in strategy development, asset management, engineering, digital solutions, and sustainability across the Built Environment to improve performance, resilience and commercial outcomes.
   

  

 We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Transport Consultant to join our prestigious team in Dubai, UAE, to work on some of the world’s best and most complex projects.
   

  

**Client leadership and engagement management**
* Act as the primary day‑to‑day leader for Operations engagements, accountable for on‑time, on‑budget delivery and client satisfaction across multiple workstreams.
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders (ministries, delivery entities, asset owners, operators, investors), serving as a strategic advisor on asset operations, service models and transformation roadmaps.
* Shape engagement scope, workplans, staffing and budgets, ensuring alignment with client priorities, contractual commitments and Buro Happold quality standards.


**Integrated Buro Happold offer development**
* Combine capabilities from Asset Consultancy, Advisory, Digital, Sustainability and core Engineering teams into coherent, repeatable Operations offerings tailored to KSA clients.
* Capture and codify methods, tools and case studies from live projects to create playbooks and accelerators for asset operations, performance improvement and transformation.
* Collaborate with regional and global leadership to refine the growth strategy for Strategy and Operations services, including priority sectors, geographies and key accounts.


**Business development and practice building**
* Originate and lead Operations opportunities with new and existing clients, including proposal leadership, pitch delivery and framework responses.
* Represent Buro Happold in market‑facing forums in KSA and the GCC, articulating our perspective on asset operations.
* Mentor and develop junior consultants and engineers, contributing to a high‑performing, diverse and collaborative regional advisory team.


**Operating Model design**
* Lead the development of operating models and implementation plans for portfolios of assets transitioning into operation, including roles and responsibilities, service delivery models and outsourcing/insourcing options.
* Define performance frameworks, KPIs and governance structures that link asset operations to wider programme objectives (e.g. Vision 2030, ESG, visitor experience, revenue and cost optimisation).
* Work with sector and technical specialists to input to commercial models that quantify lifecycle costs, whole‑life value and operational risk, informing investment and operating decisions.


**Your Skills And Experience**
* Significant experience (typically 8–12 years) in management consulting, strategy and operations, asset management or related advisory roles, ideally with exposure to large‑scale infrastructure, urban development or real estate portfolios.
* Strong track record leading complex consulting engagements or programmes, including responsibility for client relationships, delivery management, team leadership and commercial performance.
* Demonstrable experience in the KSA market, with understanding of public‑sector structures, delivery entities and the transition from capital delivery to asset operations.
* Deep understanding of operating model design, asset operations, facilities management, performance management and continuous improvement in an infrastructure or built‑environment context.
* Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary technical teams (engineering, digital, sustainability, economics) and synthesise their inputs into clear strategic recommendations for senior decision‑makers.
* Excellent communication, facilitation and stakeholder‑management skills, including comfort operating at executive and board level and presenting complex analysis in a clear, actionable way.
* Degree in Engineering, Business, Economics or a related discipline; a postgraduate qualification (e.g. MSc, MBA) and/or relevant professional certifications in asset management or operations would be advantageous.


**Personal qualities**
* Strategic, delivery‑focused mindset with the ability to connect high‑level vision to detailed operating realities across large asset portfolios.
* Collaborative and entrepreneurial approach, with a strong desire to shape and grow an emerging Operations offering within Buro Happold.


 Resilient, adaptable and comfortable working in a fast‑paced, evolving environment as Saudi Arabia’s major programmes move from planning into long‑term operation.
   

  

**What We Offer You**
* Bring your knowledge and expertise to one of the world’s most respected consultancies.
* Hybrid working arrangements.
* Attractive salary and benefits package
* A strong commitment to your continuous development. Whatever stage in your career, we have a learning and development programme that will enable and empower you
* Entitlement to two memberships to professional bodies or subscriptions
* An international culture that wherever your career takes you at Buro Happold, you won’t be far from the exceptional.


**At Buro Happold, everyone else’s extraordinary is just our everyday. Apply today and be a part of our legacy.**
**A place for everyone**
 Buro Happold values individual's flexible approaches to working patterns as an important part of the way you work and achieve balance. We welcome applications from those who are seeking flexibility in their careers.
   

  

 Our exceptional portfolio of projects is the result of the diversity of thought, identities, backgrounds and experiences that shape us. Appreciating each other’s differences is key, we want employees to feel they don’t have to mask elements of their identity to thrive.
   

  

 We are working to change the lack of representation of marginalised groups in the built environment and are particularly keen to hear from anyone who feels they are underrepresented in the industry. We have much to learn from one another. Embracing difference allows us to develop the most innovative and elegant solutions.
   

  

 Please let us know if there are any adjustments, we could make to the application process to make it easier and more comfortable for you. Contact recruitment@burohappold.com so we can work with you to support you throughout your application.

data.jd_text:
TradePay, a Sanabil Studio company, is redefining how B2B commerce operates by enabling suppliers and distributors to offer flexible payment terms to business merchants through a seamless Stock\-Now\-Pay\-Later solution.
   

  

 Backed by Sanabil Studio, TradePay combines technology, financing infrastructure, and operational expertise to help businesses unlock working capital, improve cash flow, and scale more efficiently across industries.
   

  

**THE ROLE** 
 What you'll own here.
   

  

* Lead the development of AI\-enabled products across credit decisioning, fraud and risk monitoring, dynamic limit management, and inventory and cashflow intelligence.
* Translate complex, real\-world data into decision tools that improve accuracy, reduce loss rates, and responsibly expand access to finance.
* Drive a responsible AI approach, including model monitoring, drift detection, explainability, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows where required.
* Own the architecture and engineering roadmap from pilot through MVP to scale, ensuring systems are secure, scalable, and maintainable.
* Build and operate a modern data and ML platform covering ingestion, feature pipelines, training, serving, experimentation, and monitoring.
* Define AI work streams, milestones, and measurable outcomes; including approval lift, loss reduction, time\-to\-decision, and merchant growth impact.
* Establish technical standards across code quality, CI/CD, observability, reliability, and documentation.
* Make pragmatic build\-versus\-buy decisions across infrastructure, data providers, scoring components, KYC tooling, and payment rails.
* Hire, develop, and lead a high\-performing engineering and data team in Riyadh.
* Build strong security and privacy foundations that can withstand audits and support future licensing requirements.
* Partner closely with Risk, Operations, Finance, Legal/Compliance, and Partnerships teams.


**THE PROFILE** 
 You're probably a fit if…
   

  

* You have proven experience shipping AI/ML\-powered products into production; not just prototypes.
* You bring strong software engineering fundamentals alongside hands\-on experience in machine learning and data platforms.
* You have experience in fintech, lending, BNPL, payments, risk, fraud, or underwriting, and understand the importance of correctness in these environments.
* You have a track record of turning complex datasets into real\-world decision tools with measurable business impact.
* You have hired, mentored, and led teams in fast\-paced, ambiguous environments.
* You take full ownership of outcomes and maintain high standards for reliability, security, and scalable architecture.
* You communicate clearly with engineers, executives, and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* You are based in Riyadh or open to relocation; this is an on\-site leadership role.
* Bonus: Experience with credit bureaus, alternative data, open banking signals, cloud\-native architectures at scale, regulated environments, or GCC fintech products.


**THE ENVIRONMENT** 
 : What working here actually looks like.
   

  

* Builder Role, Real Scope: You won’t be maintaining an existing system; you’ll define the architecture, build the team, and own outcomes from day one.
* AI at the Core: AI is central to how TradePay operates, from underwriting to risk monitoring and merchant intelligence, and you will lead that effort.
* Close to the Top: You will work directly with the CEO and leadership team in Riyadh, with fast feedback loops and real influence on company direction.


**What You Get From Us**
* Competitive pay: A package that reflects your seniority and the market.
* Meaningful equity: Real upside tied to the long\-term value you help create.
* Premium gear, day one: Fully set up and ready before your first day.
* Mentorship that matters: Learn from people who have built and scaled ventures.
* An accelerated curve: You’ll learn more here in 12 months than most roles offer in three years.

**Job Description**
**Position Summary**
 The Commercial Strategy Director will lead the strategic commercialization, launch readiness, and execution planning for Vertex’s asset in glomerular diseases including IgA nephropathy across the GCC markets, with a primary focus on Saudi Arabia.
   

  

 This role is accountable for shaping and executing the GCC portfolio strategy, identifying and driving market\-shaping opportunities, and ensuring alignment with Vertex’s global priorities and cross\-functional objectives.
   

  

 The successful candidate will combine strategic leadership, deep market understanding, and strong cross\-functional influence to accelerate access, optimize launch execution, and position Vertex as a leading innovator in glomerular diseases within the region. The role requires a leadership mindset grounded in ambition, anticipation, and agility, with the ability to proactively navigate evolving healthcare environments and deliver sustainable business impact.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead the development and execution of the GCC commercial strategy for Povetacicept, ensuring alignment with Vertex’s global vision and regional healthcare transformation priorities.
* Drive launch excellence initiatives, go\-to\-market planning, customer engagement strategies, value proposition development, and access readiness efforts specific to glomerular diseases, including IgA Nephropathy.
* Identify, prioritize, and maximize commercial opportunities across the GCC markets through deep understanding of market dynamics, healthcare policies, competitive landscape, and evolving standards of care.
* Operate with a high degree of strategic anticipation and agility to proactively address evolving market conditions, and emerging business opportunities and risks.
* Own delivery against agreed commercial and strategic objectives, ensuring strong execution against revenue, growth, operational, and efficiency KPIs.
* Generate and consolidate actionable market insights across HCPs and patient stakeholders to inform strategic decision\-making and brand planning.
* Lead cross\-functional launch readiness efforts in partnership in participation with Medical, Market Access, Regulatory, Government and Public Affairs (GAPP), and International Patient Engagement (IPE), Supply Chain, and Finance teams to ensure coordinated and successful product launches.
* Partner closely with international IHQ teams to drive strategic and operational alignment required to address evolving markets and healthcare system needs.
* Drive launch excellence through disciplined planning, execution governance, risk mitigation, and performance tracking across all launch phases.
* Drive integrated strategic planning and operational excellence across internal stakeholders, ensuring customer and market needs are effectively translated into execution plans and organizational priorities.
* Develop robust business cases supporting investment decisions, resource allocation, capability building, and portfolio expansion across the region.
* Collaborate within external nephrology and glomerular disease ecosystem through strategic engagement with scientific leaders, healthcare institutions, policymakers, and advocacy stakeholders.
* Represents the GCC region in regional and global strategic forums, ensuring GCC needs and insights are reflected in broader organizational planning.
* Represents Vertex externally at scientific meetings, conferences, industry events, and strategic engagement to strengthen the company’s profile and support long\-term business development opportunities.
* Ensure all commercial activities are conducted in full compliance with Vertex code of conduct, SOPs and all applicable laws and regulations across GCC markets.


 Required Education Level
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Pharmaceutical/Life Sciences or related discipline and/ or MBA or advanced business degree

* Strong experience across GCC markets, with Saudi Arabia experience considered essential.


**Required Knowledge \& Skills**
* Strong cross\-functional leadership capabilities with proven ability to operate effectively within complex matrix organizations.
* Demonstrated success in developing and implementing commercial strategies that drive measurable business outcomes. Experience in successfully launching innovative and preferably rare disease therapies in GCC healthcare systems.

* Proven ability to influence and collaborate effectively across cross\-functional teams and senior leadership levels.
* Strong track record of effectively engaging with healthcare providers, and government stakeholders in the GCC.

* Demonstrated ability to anticipate challenges, navigate uncertainty, and lead through complexity and change.
* Strong project management and operational planning capabilities.
* Excellent communication (written and verbal), and presentation skills.
* Sound understanding of compliance frameworks and regulatory requirements across GCC markets.
* Excellent command of oral and written English and Arabic.


**Other Requirements**
* Frequent travel within GCC may be required.
* Position is based in Riyadh, KSA.


**Flex Designation**
 Hybrid\-Eligible Or On\-Site Eligible
   

  

**Flex Eligibility Status**

* Hybrid: work remotely up to two days per week; or select
* On\-Site: work five days per week on\-site with ad hoc flexibility.


 Note: The Flex status for this position is subject to Vertex’s Policy on Flex @ Vertex Program and may be changed at any time.

 Vision \& Strategy:

* Strengthen relationships with key clients and stakeholders, ensuring exceptional satisfaction and trust in WSP’s delivery capabilities.


 Operational Excellence:
   

  

* Oversee the delivery of high\-quality consulting and engineering services, ensuring projects meet mission\-critical standards for resilience, efficiency, and sustainability across data centres specifically.


 P\&L Accountability:
   

  

* Drive financial performance by achieving key Profit \& Loss (P\&L) targets, optimizing resource allocation, and ensuring sustainable growth.


 Business Development:
   

  

* Lead strategic initiatives to expand WSP’s footprint in the Middle East data centre market, securing new opportunities and partnerships.


 Quality, Safety \& Operations (QSO):
   

  

* Uphold WSP’s commitment to quality, safety, and operational excellence, setting the tone for industry\-leading standards in mission\-critical delivery.


 Leadership \& Team Management

Foster a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive culture centered on growth, technical excellence, strategic advisory services and accountability across business lines and global regions.


 Emerging Technologies \& Future\-Ready Solutions:

* 15\+ years of experience in mission\-critical/data centre projects, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.
* Strong understanding of: Data centre MEP/HVAC systems, Electrical redundancy / Tier levels, Uptime Institute standards, Cooling and energy optimisation strategies, Commissioning processes \& operational readiness, Mission‑critical resilience and risk engineering
* Experience working within Middle East regulatory frameworks (UAE/KSA at minimum).
* Proven track record in business development, client management, and P\&L ownership.
* Strong technical understanding of data centre design, construction, and operations.
* Experience leading senior technical experts, sector teams, or multi\-disciplinary delivery teams.


**Core Leadership Capabilities**
* Exceptional leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong commercial acumen and experience with P\&L or division\-level budget ownership.
* Ability to manage multiple large\-scale, complex projects simultaneously under aggressive timelines.
* Deep understanding of data center\-specific design considerations, including redundancy factors and industry regulatory frameworks.
* Evidence of building culture, driving accountability, and setting governance structures.

**Company Description**

*If you want to do career\-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.*
*With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.*
**The Role**
 Checkout.com is seeking a talented Senior Financial Partnerships Specialist in Riyadh to join the adventure and support our rapid growth and expansion in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
   

  

 Working with a regional team, your main responsibility will be to manage and grow our partnerships with Acquiring Banks, APMs and card networks such as Visa, Mastercard and MADA. You will contribute to the development and execution of our strategy for such partnerships.

* Negotiate the most favorable operational and commercial outcomes for Checkout.com while balancing internal and external stakeholders
* Ensure existing processes are followed and deliverables are met by both sides in a partnership. Design and develop new processes to scale those partnerships for growth, efficiency and performance improvement.
* Collaborate effectively with various functions in the partner organization such as relationship management, business development, risk, compliance, product and operations across all levels.

data.jd_text:
**About Us**
 Tamara is the leading fintech platform in Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC region with a mission to help people make their dreams come true by building the most customer\-centric financial super\-app on earth. The company serves millions of users in the region and partners with leading global and regional brands such as SHEIN, Jarir, noon, IKEA and Amazon, as well as small and medium businesses.
   

  

 Tamara is Saudi Arabia’s first fintech unicorn and is backed by Sanabil Investments, a wholly owned company by the Public Investment Fund (PIF), SNB Capital, Checkout.com, amongst others. The company operates from its headquarters in Riyadh, with additional regional and global support offices.
   

  

**Your Role**
 The Senior Manager \- Credit Risk will play a critical role in safeguarding the company's financial interests by effectively managing credit risk and preventing fraudulent activities. This position involves developing and implementing risk strategies, conducting thorough analysis, and collaborating with cross\-functional teams to maintain a secure and reliable financial environment. This role will be based in our Riyadh, HQ.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
* Develop and implement credit risk policies, strategies, and procedures.
* Assess creditworthiness of applicants through credit scoring models, credit reports, and financial analysis.
* Monitor and manage credit exposure, delinquency rates, and portfolio performance.
* Continuously optimize risk and pricing strategies to maximize profitability while minimizing credit losses.
* Develop and implement fraud prevention strategies and controls.
* Monitor transactions and customer behavior for signs of fraudulent activity.
* Investigate suspicious transactions and collaborate with law enforcement agencies when necessary.
* Stay updated on emerging fraud trends and technologies.
* Utilize data analytics to identify and assess credit and fraud risks.
* Prepare regular reports and dashboards to communicate risk trends and performance to senior management.
* Implement data\-driven decision\-making processes.
* Ensure compliance with relevant financial regulations and industry standards.
* Collaborate with the compliance team to address regulatory requirements related to credit and fraud risk management
* Work closely with product, engineering, and customer service teams to integrate risk management measures into product design and customer interactions.
* Provide guidance on risk implications during new product development.
* Balance risk mitigation measures with a seamless and positive customer experience.
* Communicate risk policies and actions to customers effectively and transparently


**Your expertise**
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Risk Management, or a related field. Master's degree or relevant certifications (e.g., FRM, CFE) is a plus.
* Proven experience of 8\+ years in credit risk management and fraud prevention, preferably in the fintech industry.
* Strong understanding of credit scoring models, underwriting processes, and fraud detection methods.
* Proficiency in data analysis and risk modeling.
* Knowledge of financial regulations and compliance requirements.
* Familiarity with risk management software and tools.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
* Problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.

**Responsibilities :** 



  
 * Establish, manage, and continuously enhance the sanctions framework across the organization, including policies, procedures, controls, governance, and operating model, in line with SAMA Sanctions Rules and international best practices.
* Define the sanctions strategy, annual objectives, KPIs, and the annual sanctions program, ensuring alignment with regulatory expectations and business risk profile.
* Monitor, interpret, and implement all SAMA circulars, directives, and instructions related to sanctions, targeted financial sanctions (TFS), and proliferation financing (PF), ensuring timely implementation within defined target dates.

Sanabil Studio is a venture builder that blends industry expertise, technology, and startup know\-how to turn bold ideas into real businesses. We take concepts from zero to launch, and when a venture proves its potential, we back it with seed funding and hands\-on support to help it scale.
   

  

 TradePay is one of those ventures building the trade finance infrastructure for FMCG in Saudi Arabia. Our mission is to replace informal supplier credit with structured, data\-driven working capital that helps small merchants grow, protects suppliers from credit risk, and strengthens the FMCG supply chain. We are building a new credit system for underbanked merchants where risk is priced from real transaction behavior, not balance sheets. Our model leverages supplier, distributor, and marketplace data to power embedded B2B BNPL experiences across FMCG ecosystems. This is not traditional lending this is supply\-chain\-native decisioning built from real commerce data.
   

  

 We are looking for a Head of Operations to build and lead TradePay's operational backbone from the ground up reporting directly to the CEO.
   

  

**THE ROLE What you'll own here** 
 .

* Manage repayment reminder strategies across SMS, WhatsApp, calls, and automated payment systems

 How Success Will Be Measured Scalable collections infrastructure fully operational, automated reminder and collections engine implemented, merchant support function operating to defined SLAs, real\-time operational reporting and dashboards live, reconciliation and settlement processes fully controlled, dispute management framework operational, and operational readiness achieved for national scale.
   

  

 Where This Role Can Go Head of Operations → Chief Operations Officer as TradePay scales its operational infrastructure across the region.

 , day one: Everything you need to hit the ground running, set up and ready before your first morning. Mentorship that matters: Direct collaboration with the Founder and leadership team from people who've actually built and scaled ventures.

data.jd_text:
**The role**
 SiFi is building the business wallet Saudi companies actually want to use. The Platform squad owns the core of that promise: how companies control spend, capture receipts, enforce policy, and understand where their money goes. It's also the most complex surface on the platform, and your job is to make it feel simple.
   

  

 This is a product team, not a feature factory. You'll be handed problems and outcomes, not a roadmap to execute. If you need a spec to feel safe, this isn't the seat.
   

  

 We're not hiring for domain expertise. We're hiring for an instinct: to sit with a confused finance lead, find the real pain under what they say, and turn that mess into a product decision that's obviously right.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
 You'll work directly with finance leaders and business owners to surface the problems that slow them down: expense processes that take too long, policies that are hard to enforce, receipts that go missing, spend that's impossible to reconcile at month\-end.
   

  

 This role covers the full product lifecycle. You'll take new ideas from zero to one, defining the problem, validating with real users, and shipping something that works before anyone else knows it's needed. You'll scale what's already live, removing friction, improving reliability, and driving adoption across the customer base. And you'll work closely with marketing on go\-to\-market, making sure new features actually land, get used, and stick.
   

  

 Data is how you stay honest. You'll obsess over usage numbers, drop\-off points, and adoption curves, and you won't let a hypothesis live long without testing it. You act on what the data says, not what feels right.
   

  

 Your job is to understand user pain deeply, then turn it into product decisions that make the platform dramatically simpler to use.
   

  

**How We Work**
 Small squads, real ownership, weekly customer contact, high taste bar. We move fast and we say no to most things so we can do a few things at a world\-class level.
   

  

**Requirements**
**What we're looking for**
* 2\+ years shipping B2B SaaS products people use daily. You've owned a real surface, not assisted on one.
* You have a genuine pull toward customers. You talk to users every week because you want to, not because a process tells you to. You hear what people don't say, and you keep asking "why" until the real problem surfaces.
* You have a simplification instinct. Show us a flow you made dramatically simpler, and explain what you removed and why it mattered.
* You're fluent in data. You build your own dashboards, spot patterns before anyone flags them, and act on what you find. Data is your default lens, not a secondary check.
* You turn messy, contradictory customer input clear decisions, and you bring decisions to the table, not options. You write clearly, and you're decisive under ambiguity.


**Nice to have**
* Saudi or MENA market experience, and Arabic. You've felt finance\-ops pain firsthand, or are fast at building context. You've worked somewhere that treated design as a core competency, not decoration.

 Backed by Sanabil Studio, TradePay combines technology, financing infrastructure, and operational expertise to help businesses unlock working capital, improve cash flow, and scale more efficiently across industries.

* Lead product discovery, prioritization, and delivery across core platform workflows.
* Partner closely with Engineering, Risk, Operations, Partnerships, and Legal to ship reliable, scalable solutions.
* Own product requirements, backlog management, release planning, and delivery quality.
* Lead integrations with external partners and service providers.
* Define and drive product and development operating rituals \- backlog, PRDs, metrics, release readiness, and post\-mortems.

* A clear, credible roadmap executed reliably.
* Stable delivery across core workflows and partner integrations.

 What working here actually looks like.

* Coordinate with banks for technical specs, testing, and go\-live of bank interfaces

**Company Description**
*We’re* 
*Checkout.com* 
*. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.*
*We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions daily for more than one billion global shoppers.*
*Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.*
*If you want to do career\-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.*
*With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.*
 Checkout.com is actively looking for strategic\-thinking, resourceful, and highly driven Enterprise Account Managers to join our Commercial team in Dubai. We are currently hiring for multiple positions across varying levels of seniority.
   

  

 We are looking for top\-tier payments talent to join our high\-performance culture as we continue to scale after exponential growth in 2025\.
   

  

 As an Enterprise Account Manager, you are the business advisor and primary post\-integration point of contact. You will act as a trusted advisor, helping our largest merchants navigate the complex global payments landscape. You must possess the ability to influence C\-level stakeholders, the analytical rigor to perform deep dives into payment performance, and the resilience to turn difficult conversations into win\-win partnerships.
   

  

 Candidates will be assessed against a specific set of criteria for each level (Mid \& Senior) depending on their depth of payments experience and the competencies demonstrated throughout the interview process.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Driving Merchant ROI: Crafting and executing merchant\-specific development plans that focus on tangible revenue generation and value\-add.
* Performance Optimisation: Conducting deep\-dive analyses of merchant payment data to increase acceptance rates, reduce false declines, and optimize the checkout flow.
* Strategic Growth: Proactively identifying opportunities to upsell new products and features, increasing our "share of wallet" within each account.
* Retention \& Loyalty: Acting as the primary line of defense against churn by building high\-touch, consultative relationships and resolving complex merchant pain points.
* Commercial Negotiation: Navigating difficult conversations and handling pushback from sophisticated enterprise merchants with a focus on long\-term partnership.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partnering with Sales, Integration, Legal, and Product teams to ensure an outstanding, seamless merchant experience.
* Market Advocacy: Acting as the voice of our product and an ambassador of our brand, providing expertise and guidance on global payment strategies.


**About You**
* Experience: At least 4 years of experience in a B2B Enterprise Account Management or Relationship Management role within a payments or digital first business!
* Domain Expertise: Strong knowledge of e\-commerce, payment technologies, and major future trends in the financial ecosystem.
* Commercial Acumen: Proven ability to hit financial targets, reduce churn, and drive expansion revenue (upselling/cross\-selling).
* Resilience: Experience handling high\-pressure situations and pushback from difficult or demanding enterprise stakeholders.
* Analytical Mindset: Comfortable using data to tell a story; you can turn complex transaction data into actionable recommendations for a merchant.
* Adaptability: You thrive in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment and can manage multiple priorities without losing focus on performance.
* Communication: Exceptional English communication skills (Arabic is a plus), with the ability to influence at all levels of an external organization.


**Additional Information**
**Bring all of you to work**
 We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.
   

  

 Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.
   

  

 We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.
   

  

 It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.
   

  

**Life at** 
**Checkout.com**
 We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.
   

  

 Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.
   

  

 For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Purpose Summary**
 The overall role for the position is to assist the SVP/ VP Innovation to drive cultural change around one dedicated strategic innovation themes. The incumbent will manage and monitor all innovation initiatives within his/ her scope in order to ensure that they are implemented and completed within the defined time, budget and requirements with the support of the originally allocated resources. The incumbent will also be responsible for developing, driving and rolling out appropriate tracking metrics for regular reporting to core stakeholders at a project, initiative and program level.
